tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅: grub thob chen po'i thugs tig las: khrag 'thung bde gshegs 'dus pa bzhugs: khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i lha la 'dud: bod kyi rnal 'byor thang stong pa: rnga yab gling du mngon sum phyin: rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru rje: o rgyan padma rgyal po las: sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad kyi: dbang dang gdams ngag kun zhus nas: khrag 'thung dgyes pa'i zhal yang mthong : de yi snying po'i bcud bsdus pa: skal ldan don du brtse bas gdams: sa ma ya: 'di la spyi don lnga yin te: bskyed pa sku yi sgrub thabs dang : gyer bzlas gsung gi las rim dang : 'od gsal thugs kyi rdzogs rim dang : yon tan smin byed dbang bskur dang : phrin las mngon spyod gzer ka ste: mchog dang thun mong lam gyi rim: zab rgyas kun gyi snying por bstan: sa ma ya: dang po bskyed pa'i sgrub thabs ni: dbang thob dam tshig la gnas pa'i: sngags pas dur khrod dben gnas su: yid g.yengs spangs la 'di ltar bsgom: hūm̐: ma bcos spros med de bzhin nyid: kun snang snying rje'i rol pa las: thams cad skyed byed rgyu yi hūm̐: mthing nag mkha' la 'ja' ltar shar: cho 'phrul chen po'i 'od zer gyis: snod bcud dngos por 'dzin pa sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las 'byung rim steng : ri rab rdo rje'i brag chen po: srung 'khor 'jigs pa'i dur khrod dang : drag po'i gzhal yas mtshan rdzogs dgu'i: dbus mar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i lter: padma zla nyi byol song gtso: dregs pa lha chen pho mo'i steng : rgyu yi hūm̐ babs yongs su gyur: rdo rje rtse dgu hūm̐ gis mtshan: 'od zer 'phro 'du'i sbyor ba yis: khrag 'thung rab 'byams byin nus thim: de las skad cig dran rdzogs su: bdag nyid che mchog he ru ka: mthing nag dmar ba'i mdangs 'od 'tsher: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: spyan dgu sdang mig smar smin 'bar: g.yas gsum rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon:

rtse dgu rtse lnga rtse gsum gsor: g.yon gsum skam rlon rnyid pa yi: bhañdza bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang : dpal dang dur khrod chas kun rdzogs: sbyor yum gnam zhal dbyings phyug ma: sngo skya rtse gsum thod 'dzin 'khril: dar dang rus rgyan gzig sham 'phyang : gar dgu'i gzi byin mchog tu 'bar: e waṃ mnyam sbyar mkha' gsang nas: bde ba'i sgra dang 'od zer 'phros: bde gshegs sras dang btsun mor bcas: spyan drangs zhal zhugs thugs kar zhu: yum gyi padmor son pa las: hūm̐ chen 'bar ba'i sprin phung 'phros: tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar bskyed: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gtso mchog dkyil 'khor rtsibs bzhi ru: gsang ba'i khro rgyal yab yum dang : khro bcu ta kṛta sgo ba bzhi: pho nya mang po las la 'gyed: che mchog dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs: oṃ badzra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: shar dkyil 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus: dpal chen badzra he ru ka: mthing nag rdo rje dung khrag 'dzin: kro dhī shwa rī mthing skya 'khril: khrag 'thung rigs bzhi yab yum dang : gnas yul sgo skyong bka' nyan bcas: yang dag thugs kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: lho dkyil 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus: pad zla nyi ma ma he dang : gshin rje pho mo bsnol ba'i steng : zil gnon khrag 'thung mthing nag 'bar: 'khor lo bskor zhing sdig mdzub bsgrengs: sbyor yum bai ta nag mo 'khril: gshed chen bzhi dang 'chi bdag tshogs: mthar byed sgo ba bka' nyan bcas: 'jam dpal sku yi dkyil 'khor rdzogs: oṃ a kro te ka ya mānta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: nub dkyil 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus: pad zla nyi ma klu brgyad steng : rta mchog padma he ru ka: dmar smug padma dril bu 'dzin: dbu gtsug rta gdong rngams bzhi 'tsher: gzi ldan dmar po yum dang 'khril:

g.yas g.yon sprul pa'i pho nya spro: rtsibs bzhir dbang chen rigs bzhi dang : zil gnon sgo skyong pho nyar bcas: padma gsung gi dkyil 'khor rdzogs: oṃ padmānta kri ta badzra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: byang dkyil 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus: pad zla nyi ma lha chen steng : rdo rje gzhon nu mthing nag 'bar: phyag gnyis srid pa phur bu 'dril: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mthing skya 'khril: rtsibs bzhir sras mchog rigs bzhi dang : khro bcu yab yum za gsod tshogs: sgo skyong bka' nyan dang bcas pa'i: phur pa phrin las dkyil 'khor rdzogs: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: shar lho 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus: pad zla nyi ma ma mo'i steng : mngon rdzogs khrag 'thung rgyal po mthing : rdo rje gsor zhing thun khrag 'phen: nyid zhi bde mchog yum dang 'khril: rtsibs bzhi mdun gyi g.yon zur bcas: rtag pa'i rgyal mo spun lnga dang : rje mo sman mo sgo skyong sogs: srid pa ma mo'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: oṃ gu hya dzñā na kro dha kro dhī ma ma yo gi nī ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: lho nub 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus: padma nyi zla rin chen khrir: rig 'dzin rdo rje chos rab dkar: rdo rje dril 'dzin zhi chags khro: yum chen rdo rje rnal 'byor 'khril: rtsibs bzhir rig 'dzin rnam bzhi dang : grub pa'i slob dpon rnam pa brgyad: sgo skyong mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas pa: bla ma rigs 'dus dkyil 'khor rdzogs: oṃ badzra ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: nub byang 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus: padma zla nyi dregs pa'i steng : dbang chen dregs 'dul he ru ka: mthing nag rdo rje dung khrag gsol: srid pa spyi 'dul nag mo 'khril: rtsibs bzhir dregs chen sde bzhi dang : gzhan yang dregs pa sgo skyong bcas: ma rungs dregs tshogs pho nyar 'gyed:

'jig rten mchod bstod dkyil 'khor rdzogs: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣtan hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: byang shar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus: padma zla nyi dgra bgegs steng : stobs ldan nag po char sprin mdog: rdo rje gsor zhing tsitta gsol: 'byung lnga'i bdag mo yum dang 'khril: rtsibs bzhir gshed bdud srin gnod sbyin: gzhan yang dregs chen sgo skyong dang : gsod byed sde brgyad sprin phung 'phro: dmon pa drag sngags dkyil 'khor rdzogs: oṃ badzra sarba duṣtān hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: de ltar gsal ba'i khrag 'thung gtso: dur khrod dpal chas gar dgus rol: 'khor rnams dur khrod rol pa'i chas: rnam 'gyur ma nges cir yang ston: rig 'dzin dar dang rus pa'i rgyan: dregs chen rang rang cha lugs dang : drag sngags 'jigs rung mi bzad rngams: dpal dgu'i dpung pa g.yas g.yon rtser: rdo rje'i bya khyung dkar nag lding : bar khyams gnas yul phra men tshogs: phyogs mtshams dpal gyi bka' sdod dpung : sgo bzhir phyi nang sgo skyong dang : phyi rol dbang phyug mkha' 'gro ging : laṅka 'bar ma pho nya sogs: nyi ma dang ni 'od zer bzhin: snang srid gzhir bzhengs yongs rdzogs lha: chu zla 'ja' tshon lta bur gsal: oṃ shrī he ru ka sarba maṇḍal la hūm̐: hūm̐: de ltar gsal ba'i lha tshogs kyi: gnas gsum rdo rje'i 'bru gsum mtshan: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs su byin brlabs bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ: hūm̐: slar yang mkha' khyab dbang gi lhas: ye shes bdud rtsis dbang bskur bas: sgrib dag nus rtsal yongs su rdzogs: bde gshegs rigs lngas dbur brgyan bsam: hūm̐ oṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: de nas ye shes drang bstim sogs: las rim rgyas bsdus gang 'thad bya: khyad par rig 'dzin sgrub pa ni: bskyed pa'i rim pa'i ting 'dzin la: gsal brtan dag pa'i gzer btab nas:

rtse gcig mnyam gzhag sems brtan pas: g.yo thob goms brtan mthar phyin nas: yid dang dbang po lus kyi yul: gsal ba gsum ldan drod rtags 'byung : tha mal snang zhen lha skur dag: rlung sems zung 'jug skur ldang ba'i: rnam smin la sogs rig 'dzin thob: sku yi rnal 'byor grub pa'o: sa ma ya: gnyis pa gyer bzlas sgrub thabs la: gyer thabs phrin las bzlas rim gnyis: dang po phrin las sngon dngos rjes: sngon 'gro ji skad bshad pa yi: mtshan nyid kun tshang slob dpon las: snod ldan slob mas dbang bskur zhu: dam tshig dag pas bzhi bzung nas: dben zhing yid 'thad sgrub gnas su: rgyud dag chos mthun grogs bcas sam: yang na rang nyid gcig pu yis: mkho ba'i yo byad tshogs par bya: spro na sa yi cho ga dang : phyi nang gsang ba'i mtshams bcad sogs: rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin du bya: lhag pa'i lha dang bum pa rnams: sta gon rim pas lhag par gnas: bsdu na mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor cher: bskyed pa bzhin du 'bri ba'am: maṇḍal me tog tshom bu dgu: khyad par dpal gyi phur bu dgod: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs bsham: bde ba'i stan la legs 'dug ste: dang po bka' bsgo mtshams srung ni: hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs: byang chub sgrub la bar chad kun: song zhig lha min lha yang rung : dpal chen khrag 'thung bka' thos nas: da lta nyid du so sor dengs: gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na: lus ngag yid gsum rdul du rlog: de bas da lta phyir dengs shig: drag sngags dang bcas thun gyis brdeg: hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen he ru ka'i: nyi zla 'bar ba'i sdang mig gis: bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bsregs shing sbyangs: thugs nas khro mtshon me phung 'phros: mtshon cha'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du: phyogs skyong gdan la khro tshogs 'bar: ye shes me dpung 'tshubs shing 'khyil: rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che: padma ral gri tho ba dang : phur pa'i mtshon cha sprin ltar gtibs:

lha sngags ye shes rgyas btab pas: nam yang 'da' ba'i skabs med do: badzra tsakra ratna padma khaḍga tīkṣ+ṇa dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: badzra raksha raksha bhrūm̐: gnyis pa skyabs sems tshogs bsag phyir: mkha' khyab tshogs rten spyan drangs mdun: yan lag brgyad kyis rgyud sbyang bya: rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal: dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo: mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing gyur la: gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs: nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi: phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos: ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang : dag pa mtha' bzhi'i dri ma med: rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do: bde gshegs dbang phyug sems can la: dgos pa gsum phyir lus 'bul lo: tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i dge ba rnams: bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo: gsum pa brda yi sgo dbye zhing : gnyis su med pa'i phyag gis 'dud: hūm̐: gnyis 'dzin rtog pas bcad pa'i brda yi sgau: rig pa rang gsal chen po'i ngang du dbye: lhun rdzogs byang chub sems kyi dpal chen po: mngon sum rig ngor mjal ba'i phyag gis 'dud: bhrūm̐ dzñā na maṇḍa la pra we sha ya phaṭa: a la la ho: a ti pū hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ bzhi pa rgyud dag snod rung phyir: gdung ba'i shugs bskyed nongs pa bshags: hoḥ don dam dmigs med spros dang bral ba la: nyams dang bshags par bya ba ma dmigs kyang : kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i dbang gis las bsags pa: snying nas 'gyod pas mthol bshags bzod par bzhes: yi ge brgya pa brjod: lnga pa sdom pa'i dam bca' bzung : hoḥ bdag gis mkha' khyab 'gro ba kun don tu: spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig gzung : dpal chen lha tshogs rtse gcig sgrub lags na: ye shes chen po'i byin gyis brlabs tu gsol: sarba ma hā yo ga sa ma ya bo dhi tsitta utpā da yā mi:

drug pa bdag gnas yo byad la: ye shes gzi byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings las rang byung ba'i: zhi khro rab 'byams bka' brgyad lha: dpa' bo dhā ki chos srung tshogs: thugs rje thugs dam dus la bab: sgrub pa po la byin chen phob: sgrub gnas 'og min zhing du sgyur: sgrub pa'i yo byad dam tshig rdzas: bde ba chen por byin rlobs shig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru ma hā shrī he ru ka dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba sa ma ya dzñā na ā be sha ya a āḥ hrīṃ hrīṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdun pa mchod rdzas byin brlab ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: ye shes rang rtsal me rlung chus: mchod rdzas dngos 'dzin bsregs gtor sbyangs: phyi nang gsang ba rmad byung ba'i: 'dod yon bde chen rgyan du gyur: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai bidyā shabda sarba pū dza āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: oṃ ma hā rakta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: bo dhi tsitta ga ṇa guu hya sa ma ya āḥhūm̐: de ni sngon 'gro'i las rim mo: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i dang po la: ting 'dzin gsum gyis dkyil 'khor bskyed: rgyas gdab dbang bskur sngon 'gro bas: gnyis pa ye shes spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐: khams gsum las 'das 'og min zhing : 'bar ba chen po'i pho brang nas: zhi khro rab 'byams bka' brgyad lha: gdug pa 'dul phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: shrī he ru ka maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi: badzra sa mā dza: gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: dbyings nas rang shar ye shes lha: rig pa rang snang dam tshig par: dbyer med brtan par bzhugs nas kyang : mchog thun dngos grub byin dbang stsol: sa ma ya dzñā na dzaḥhūṃ bam̐ ho: bzhi pa gus phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs dang ldan: yon tan phrin las bsam mi khyab: khrag 'thung rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lhar: gus pa'i brda yis phyag 'tshal lo:

a ti pū to: pra tītstsha ho: lnga pa mchod pa'i las rim la: thun mong phyag rgya gar dang ni: ye shes sgra brnyan glu yis mchod: oṃ: lhar snang phyag rgya chen po'i ngang : chos kyi phyag rgya'i yi ger bcas: dam tshig phyag rgya'i dgyes mchod 'bul: las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: shrī he ru ka sarba ma hā mu dra pū dza ho: hūm̐: ye shes snying po'i srog ldan pas: 'gro 'ong rlung gi rgyud dang sbyar: sgra brnyan rol mo mtshungs med pas: bde chen longs spyod mchog tu rol: ma hā dzñā na te na hūm̐: te na te te hūm̐: nyer spyod phyi yi mchod par spro: oṃ: mchod pa chen po chags pa che: me tog bdug pa mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo'i sprin phung gis: dgyes bskyed dngos grub mchog stsol mdzod: oṃ pa na peṃ: peṃ nu su ra tā: ti pu pa ra mu: sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi hu: sa ma yo ta mu: sarba ma hā su kha siddhi hu: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga dhū pe dhū: puṣpe pu: ā lo ke hrī: gandhe gan: nai bidyā ā: shabda hoḥ nang ltar bdud rtsis mchod pa ni: hūm̐: rang byung gdod nas rnam dag pa: sha lnga bdud rtsi ye shes lnga: dag mnyam rtogs pa'i phud mchod kyis: dpal chen lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: sarba pañtsa amṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hi: dgongs pa brda dang snyan nas brgyud pa yi: byin rlabs sprin phung ye shes char chen 'bebs: rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang rtsa brgyud bla ma la: sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hiḥ ye shes klong dgu'i rang gzugs dpal chen po: bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams 'dus pa'i lha: dngos grub mchog stsol bsam yas dkyil 'khor la: sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol: ma hā pañtsa amṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi: dpal gyi bka' sdod phrin las glog ltar 'khyugs: ma sring mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho dang : snang srid gzhir bzhengs rdo rje'i maṇḍa lar:

sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hi: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dam tshig rdzas kyi bdud rtsi las: ye shes snying po'i dngos grub dbyig: mtheb srin nyi zla'i gwa'u yis: rdo rje lce la bzhag cing myang : kā ya wā ka tsitta a mṛ ta siddhi pha la ho: rjes 'brel longs spyod gtor mas mchod: hūm̐: snod kyi 'jig rten gtor gzhong du: bcud kyi 'gro kun gtor mar sbyar: longs spyod rnam pa thams cad pas: dpal chen dkyil 'khor mnyes gyur cig: ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: dmar chen raktas gzi byin bskyed: hūm̐: mkha' dbyings rakta bde ba'i rgyun: khams gsum bsgral ba'i khrag dang sbyar: gzi byin chen po'i mchod pa 'dis: dpal chen dkyil 'khor dgyes pa bskyed: ma hā rakta khā hi: gsang ba byang sems dza gad 'bul: hūm̐: e waṃ mnyam par sbyor ba las: rdo rje sems dpa'i bde chen drangs: dza gad dpa' bo'i mchod pa 'dis: dpal chen lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: bo dhi tsitta dza gad pū dza hoḥ rmad byung sbyor sgrol zung 'jug mchod: hūm̐: thabs shes snyoms 'jug sbyor ba yis: gzung 'dzin ru dra dbyings su bsgral: gnyis med blo 'das rdzogs pa che: mchog gi dam tshig chen por bzhes: sta na ga ṇa ma hā dzñā na pū dza ho: drug pa che ba'i yon tan bstod: hūm̐: sgeg dpa' 'jigs rung rdo rje'i sku: dgod gshe drag shul sngags kyi gsung : snying rje rngam zhi'i ye shes thugs: dpal chen he ru ka la bstod: shin tu zhi ba rdo rje'i dbyings: ye shes rang snang khrag 'thung lha: gang 'dul thabs kyis gtso dang 'khor: sprul par ston la phyag 'tshal bstod: mthu rtsal rang byung ga ru ḍa: dpal gyi bka' sdod srung ma'i tshogs: ma sring dbang phyug ging laṅka: pho nyar bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdun pa bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi: dgongs pa gsal btab bzlas brjod bya: de ni dngos gzhi'i las rim mo:

gsum pa rjes kyi las rim la: dang po thun mtshams dam tshig rdzas: tshogs dang gtor mas mchod pa ni: sha chang gtso gyur dam rdzas rnams: legs bshams bdud rtsi bsang zhing sbyang : 'dod 'byung bdud rtsi'i sprin du spel: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin rtsal: me rlung chu yis bsregs gtor bkrus: rang byung bhandhar dam rdzas bcud: mkha' khyab 'dod yon rol par spail: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrī: tshogs zhing gdung bas spyan drang bya: hūm̐: 'og min gnas dang nyer bzhi'i yul: dur khrod rol pa'i zhing kun nas: rtsa gsum zhi khro rab 'byams lha: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs: shrī he ru ka sarba maṇḍa la e ā' ralli hrīṃ hrīṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: mdun bskyed rten dang dbyer med bsam: me tog sgeg sogs

pa na peṃ sogs glu lnga dang : dhu pe sogs bzhi dang : la syā sogs bzhi: phyag rgyas mchod: tshogs phud rim pa gsum du spros: hūm̐: khrag 'thung dgyes pa'i dam tshig mchog: ye shes bdud rtsi'i tshogs kyi bcud: 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i char 'bebs pa: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por bzhes: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza sa ma ya hoḥ bar pas dam tshig nyams chags bskang : ho: bdag cag ma rig gzhan dbang gis: spyi dang khyad par lhag pa yi: dam tshig nyams chags nyes ltung kun: tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa brjod: tha ma mngon spyod bsgral bstab ni: tshogs dang rū pa 'bem du bcas: e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ni: thar med srid pa'i brub khung nang : nṛ dang tri las dgra bgegs kun: skyabs bral nyam thag tshul du bsam: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings las rang byung lha: bde gshegs zhi khro 'bar ba'i tshogs: drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: mngon spyod dmod pa'i las la bzhengs: 'gugs byed chen mo lcags kyu mas: dgra bgegs rnams shes gzugs la stims: 'ching byed chen mo zhags pa mas: dgra bgegs rnam shes rten la chings: sdom byed chen mo lcags sgrog mas: dgra bgegs lus sems dbyer med sdoms: myos byed chen mo dril bu mas: dgra bgegs dbang po myos su chug: sarba nṛ tri sha trūn bighnān badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ badzra pā sha hūm̐: badzra spho ṭa bam̐: badzra gaṇḍe ho: hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen he ru ka: phur pa sras mchog kī la ya: khams gsum sgral ba mthu ldan pa: dgra bgegs snying gi dkyil du btab: tshe bsod dwangs bcud rang la thim: gnas ngan dri ma khrus kyis sbyangs: rnam shes rgyal ba'i sras su bskyed: gzugs phung thal ba'i rdul du rlog: drag sngags mthar: sarba nṛ trī sha trūn bighnān ā yur bindu dzaḥbhrūm̐: a su nṛ tri prai du bi sho dha ya hūm̐: a yam̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭa:

sarba duṣtān bhindha bhindha ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa mā ra ya phaṭa: hūm̐: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: dug gsum tshogs mchod bla na med: dpal chen 'khor bcas dgyes par bzhes: mngon spyod phrin las yongs rdzogs mdzod: sarba sha trūn bighnān mām̐ sa rakta kiṃ ni ri ti ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: spro na skong ba ci rigs bya: bar pa rnal 'byor tshogs su rol: lus kyi dkyil 'khor dgyes par bsam: tha ma phud lhag gtor ma btang : hūm̐: phud kyis lha tshogs dgyes pa bskang : bar du rnal 'byor tshogs la rol: tha ma lhag la dbang ba'i tshogs: 'dir gshegs dpal gyi pham phabs bzhes: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ ma ma dhā ka dhā ki nī e ā ralli hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥ hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud ni: dbang phyug ging lang ma sring bran: pho nya 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs: khrag 'thung chen po'i bka' phabs rol: rdo rje'i yal gam bcas pa ltar: rnal 'byor 'khor srung rkyen rnams zlog: tshe sring dpal skyed 'byor pa spel: bcol ba'i las kun myur du sgrub: oṃ uṣtsiṣta ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: rjes 'brel gtor ma bskyang ba ni: ye shes dpal gyi thugs dam bskul: hūm̐: dpal chen tshom bu dgu yi lha: chos sku zhi las ma g.yos kyang : gzugs sku 'jigs pa'i phyag rgyar bzhengs: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma bzhes: bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi: mi mthun rdo rje'i go chas srungs: tshe dpal ye shes byin gyis bskyed: 'gal rkyen dmod pa'i stobs kyis zlog: gdug cing gtum pa dbyings su sgrol: las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: 'jig rten rgyud gsum tha tshig bsgrag: hūm̐: sngon tshe bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams dang : bar du grub mchog rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i sde: tha mar rtsa brgyud bla mas bka' bsgos ltar: pho mo ma ning snang srid dregs pa'i tshogs: tha tshig rgyud bskul sha khrag gtor ma long :

sangs rgyas bstan srung dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod: sdang ba'i dgra thul gnod pa'i bgegs dpung choms: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bshal chus bod skyong brtan ma mchod: hūm̐ bhyo: khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku'i: bka' yi tshogs dang dam tshig bdag: bod skyong brtan ma 'khor bcas rnams: 'dir gshegs dam bskang phrin las mdzod: gnag cing gdug pa'i bdud mo bzhi: dmar gsal rjes chags gnod sbyin bzhi: dkar sham zhi ba'i sman mo bzhi: skyong ma ya ma'i tshogs bcas rnams: sngon tshe padma thod phreng dang : rlangs chen dpal gyi seng ge yis: a su ra yi brag phug tu: tshogs kyi gral du bkod pa'i tshe: tha tshig zhal bzhes rjes dgongs la: bshal chu'i bdud rtsi dgyes par rol: bod khams ru bzhi'i so kha srungs: mtha' dmag gdug can rgyu 'grul chod: sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang : gangs can bde ba'i phrin las mdzod: ma ma dhā ki nī ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: mi mthun ldang med phyag rgyas mnan: hūm̐: khams gsum e yi 'brub khung du: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bkug cing bstim: rdo rje lhun po'i phyag rgyas mnan: ye shes gar gyis rgyas btab pas: byang chub sgrub la bar gcod kun: nam yang ldang ba'i skabs med do: e nṛ tri lam̐ st+waṃ bha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gnyis pa dngos grub gsol ba ni: mchod cing bstod pa sngon 'gro bas: sgrub rten bteg cing gnas gsum reg: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams thugs rje'i gter: bsnyen sgrub rdo rje'i dam tshig thems lags na: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dkyil 'khor nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub byin dbang stsol: kā ya wā ka tsitta gu ṇa karma sarba siddhi pha la ho: dngos grub rdzas la rol bar bya: gsum pa nongs tshogs bzod gsol ni: ho: rdo rje gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du: sgrub rdzas ma tshang ting 'dzin g.yel:

cho ga lhag chad 'gal 'khrul kun: bzod bzhes tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: yi ge brgya pa brjod: bzhi pa rtag mtha' sbyang ba ni: a: rig rtsal rol pa'i dkyil 'khor dang : dag pa'i snod bcud dbyings su thim: dmigs bsam brjod pa bral ba'i ngang : mkha' khyab 'od gsal ngang du bzhag: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: lnga pa chad mtha' bsal ba ni: slar yang chu la rlabs bzhin du: sgo gsum dpal chen sku gsung thugs: mi shigs rdo rje'i go dang ldan: snang srid gzhir bzhengs chen por spyod: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: drug pa bsngo smon rgyas 'debs ni: ho: dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan: ma lus 'gro ba'i don du bsngo: kun kyang dpal chen he ru ka'i: thugs kyi thig ler ro gcig shog: bdun pa shis par gsol ba ni: mi gnas ye shes kun bzang he ru ka: gang 'dul rigs kyi tshom bu'i skur ston pa: zhi khro rab 'byams bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis: rtag tu dpal gnas bkra shis bde legs shog: thun mtshams lha sngags chos sku'i ngang : zag bcas zag med dge tshogs spel: de ltar thun bzhir brtson pa ni: sgrub pa rtsa ba'i phrin las te: gzhan yang tshe dang skong dang bam: bdud rtsi mchog dang mdos gtor sogs: rgyud dang man ngag ji bzhin du: rnal 'byor ldan pas bsgrub bya ste: de yang sgrub pa chen po dang : 'brel na mchog tu 'gyur ba ste: phrin las rim pa mdo tsam ni: rgyud las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin: bsnyen rdzogs rtogs ldan ston pa dang : dad brtson brtul zhugs ldan pa'i 'khor: gnas dus yo byad phun tshogs pas: sa bzhi las su rung ba na: phyi nang gsang ba'i mtshams bcad cing : bdag nyid he ru kar gsal ba'i: thugs nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis: zhi khro bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor lha: mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs bsam: oṃ: zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs rnams: sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la: dkyil 'khor dgyes pa bskyed pa dang : slob ma rnams la snying brtse bas:

gnas 'dir dpal chen he ru ka'i: pho brang chen po 'debs 'tshal na: thugs rjes dgongs te gnang ba dang : snod bcud byin gyis brlab mdzad gsol: lan gsum gsol btab rab dgyes pas: rdo rje slob dpon snying rje che: khyod kyis rang gzhan phan gdags phyir: sgrub pa'i cho ga tshul bzhin gyis: bde gshegs rgyal bas byin rlob 'gyur: gnang ba stsal nas 'od du zhu: bdag dang gnas la thim pa yis: tha mal snang zhen rab sbyangs te: ye shes chen pos byin rlabs bsam: de nas stegs bur chag chag gdab: thig dang tshon gyis dkyil 'khor bri: yang na tshom bus mtshon pa yi: dmigs rten phyag rgya ci rigs dgram: bum pa bsgrub cing slob ma rnams: dbang bskur phyir du lhag par gnas: sgrub pa po rnams gral la dgod: mnga' gsol rtags kyi phyag rgyas gdab: khyad par bsgrub bya'i rten rdzas ni: gtso mchog thod pa'i phyag rgya sku: leb rgan dmar po'i sngags byang gsung : 'bar ba'i gnam lcags rdo rje thugs: gsang bum bdud rtsi yon tan dang : phur pa phrin las rten du dgod: de yang rten gyi gegs bsal phyir: dbus dang phyogs bzhi brtan par bzhugs: hūm̐: bde bshegs khrag 'thung rab 'byams kyi: rdo rje'i sku ni mkha' dang mnyam: phyag rgya'i rten dang dbyer med bzhugs: sku yi byin rlabs dngos grub stsol: sngags mthar kā ya dzñā na sa ma ya st+wam̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: bde gshegs khrag 'thung rab 'byams kyi: rdo rje'i gsung ni mi shigs sgra: sngags kyi rten dang dbyer med bzhugs: gsung gi byin rlabs dngos grub stsol: wā ka dzñā na sa ma ya st+waṃḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: bde gshegs khrag 'thung rab 'byams kyi: rdo rje'i thugs ni 'od gsal dbyings: phyag mtshan rten dang dbyer med bzhugs: thugs kyi byin rlabs dngos grub stsol: tsitta dzñā na sa ma ya st+wam̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: bde gshegs khrag 'thung rab 'byams kyi:

rdo rje'i yon tan lhun gyis grub: bdud rtsi'i rten dang dbyer med bzhugs: yon tan byin rlabs dngos grub stsol: gu ṇa dzñā na sa ma ya st+wam̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: bde gshegs khrag 'thung rab 'byams kyi: rdo rje'i phrin las thogs med khyab: phur bu'i rten dang dbyer med bzhugs: phrin las byin rlabs dngos grub stsol: karma dzñā na sa ma ya st+waṃ: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gzhan yang longs spyod mchod tshogs dgram: bhandha sdong bu dgu ldan pa'i: zhun chen mar me mdun du dgod: hūm̐: chos nyid gcig las rig rtsal dgu: gzi brjid sgron me 'od gsal ba: dpal chen klong dgu'i rten du bzhugs: ye shes byin rlabs dngos grub stsol: dī paṃ dzñā na dhā tu sa ma ya st+wam̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: de ltar bag dro brjid ldan bsham: ye shes gzi byin lhag par dbab: bdag dang mdun rten dbyer med bskyed: dzab skul dang bcas bzlas pa bya: thun bzhir lha sngags rgyun mi bcad: gtor ma tshogs mchod rgya chen dbul: nyul le'i bgegs dpung tshar thag bcad: slar yang ye shes dbab cing brtan: g.yeng spang rtse gcig brtson pa las: dngos nyams rmi lam rtags mthong tshe: bdag don mchog thun dngos grub blang : de la mchog dngos blang ba ni: phrin las bzhin du spyir bskul la: sku gsum thugs yon phrin las dang : ye shes rten la dgod tshig mthar: siddhi pha la btags pas blang : thun mong dbang bcu'i dngos grub ni: tshe 'brang tshe yi rdzas rnams dang : tshogs dang dza gad sogs las blang : gzhan don snod ldan slob ma rnams: dkyil 'khor gzhug cing dbang bzhi bskur: gnyis don bskul zhing gtor ma bskyang : las mjug rdo rje'i bro yis bsdu: rjes kyi cho ga spyi dang ni: sgrub rdzas cha gsum bgos nas kyang : phyag rgya la sogs rten dang ni: cha gcig ston 'khor rnams kyis bzung : cha gcig zhi rgyas me la sbyang : cha gcig rin chen gter du sba:

rdul tshon chu bo chen por gshegs: mtshams dgrol bsngo smon shis brjod spel: de ltar 'bad pas brtson 'grus dang : ting 'dzin skal pa'i khyad par bzhin: rab kyis rig 'dzin mchog dngos 'grub: 'bring gis sngags kyi drod tshad 'thob: gzhan du phrin las ci rigs 'grub: mdor na 'brel tshad don ldan pa: sgrub pa chen po'i phrin las so: de dang rjes su 'brel ba yi: rdo rje tshe yi cho ga ni: tshe bca' tshe yi gzi byin bskyed: tshul bzhin bsgrubs dang bzlas pa yis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od: pho nya dang bcas phyogs bcur khyab: rang gzhan bla tshe 'phrog nyams dang : snod bcud srid zhi'i dwangs ma kun: 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rnam par drangs: bdag la thim pas rig 'dzin grub: rdzas la thim pas bcud du 'dril: mched la thim pas nyams chags dag: khyab bdag rtag pa he ru ka'i: tshe dang ye shes rgyas par bsam: zhi khro spyi dril sngags kyi mthar: oṃ bhrūm̐ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā: zhes btags bzlas pas nus ldan bsgrub: thun mtshams thugs dam bskul ba ni: sbyar ba'i spos bsregs tshe mda' g.yab: hūm̐: ye shes klong dgu'i dkyil 'khor lha: thugs dam chen po'i dus la bab: tshe 'gugs rdo rje'i pho nya mo: 'khor 'das khams kun khyab par spros: sde brgyad 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kyis: bla tshe 'phrog pa rang sor tshud: snod kyi 'byung bzhi'i dpal dang g.yang : dwangs ma gzi brjid rten la stims: bcud kyi skye 'gro'i tshe bsod stobs: brten pa sems dang dbyer med sres: rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i dbyig: ye shes dbyings kyi thig ler sdus: mi 'gyur mi shigs rtag pa yi: dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol: zhes bskul rtags mthong dngos grub blang : hūm̐: tshe yi dngos grub rgyud gsum po: tshe srog tsitta'i thig ler stims: mi phyed sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i: dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub stsol:

kā ya wā ka tsitta ā yudzñā na siddhi hūm̐ bhrūm̐: tshe yi 'brang rgyas spyi bor blang : bza' btung bdud rtsi longs spyod bya: mthar ni tshe yis lus gang nas: mi 'gyur rtag pa'i sku thob bsam: hūm̐: tshe bcud snying dbus rten la thim: rig 'dzin tshe yi dngos grub thob: ye shes rdo rje'i phyag rgya yis: rtag pa dam par rgyas gdab bo: dzñā na badzra rakṣa rakṣa bhrūm̐: de ltar nyams su blangs pa yis: dus min 'chi ba'i bar chad zhi: dpal chen rdo rje he ru ka'i: tshe dang lang tsho thob par 'gyur: nyams chags bshags shing skong ba ni: phyi nang mchod tshogs ci 'byor bsham: khyad par sman gtor rakta dang : gsal ba'i mar me brgya rtsa sbar: tshogs rten bzhugs dang spyan drangs par: lus kyis dam bshags brkyang phyag 'tshal: ngag gis yi ge brgya pa bzlas: ltung ba'i ming nas mthol zhing bshags: yid kyis klong bshags dgongs pa bskyang : sman gtor rakta mar mes bskang : gsang chen rdo rje'i rigs gcig tu: smon lam dag pas mtshams sbyar na: tshom bu dang bcas dag cing grol: dngos grub bam gyis sgrub pa ni: brtul zhugs zil ldan rnal 'byor pas: bkra shis gtsang ma'i bam btsal la: ke'u seng rdo rje'i 'gros dang bcas: hūm̐: chen sngags kyi sgra bsgrags blang : bgegs bcom rdo rje'i bro yis gdul: dag par bkrus shing gnas nas drang : dbang bskur dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhag: che mchog lus dkyil lhar bcas bskyed: 'od zer spro bsdus dngos grub kun: rten der dgug cing rang la bsdu: spyi sngags sham bur 'di gdags bsnyen: spha ra ṇa phaṭa: ma hā sarba siddhi ti ra siddhi pha la hoḥsaṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐ ā: skabs su mchod bstod bshags skong bya: mthar ni lha tshogs rang la bstim: snyigs ma'i rten la dgra bgegs dgug: kha sbyor dbye zhing rgyab nas bsil: dkyil 'khor dbus dang phyogs mtshams dgod: mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor tshul bzhin bsgrub:

bam skong mchod pa rgyas par bya: lha tshogs sha khrag rus pas dgyes: snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems: dngos grub kun gyi dbyig chen po: bam gyi cha shas rnams la thim: ro bcud byin rlabs nus ldan bsam: rang nyid he ru ka dpal kyi: brtul zhugs brtan pos rol zhing sbyin: nyams chags dag cing dngos grub thob: bde gshegs khrag 'thung lha tshogs dang : brtul zhugs skal pa mnyam par mos: smon lam gdab cing shis pa brjod: des ni nyams chags rab tu dag: mchog thun dngos grub myur 'thob 'gyur: dam rdzas cha shas ma nyams pa: 'du ba gang la gang bsngags pa'i: sman dang sbyar nas ril bur bya: nus pa 'bum du bskyed pa yis: nad kyi khrong khyer stong par byed: bde chen bdud rtsi'i sgrub pa ni: mchog tu sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: phal pa rtsa ba yan lag sman: khrol bur sbyangs shing phye mar btags: chang chu 'o ma rin chen dang : phabs sbyor sbol te dal dbus su: chas su gzhug cing brtan par bzhag: drod 'bebs tshil chen mar me sbar: dkyil 'khor mdun du zhal bsgyur zhing : sbyor thabs brgyad kyis bde chen dbab: ra sa yā na'i rgya mtshor bskyil: bzlas sgom ting 'dzin rtse gcig bsgrub: rtags mthong rang nyid dngos grub blang : slob ma la yang sbyin par bya: 'dis ni thun mong dngos grub dang : mchog tu mi 'gyur bde chen 'grub: mthong thos myang tshor 'brel tshad kun: he ru ka dpal dngos grub 'thob: bla med mchog gi las sbyor te: rnal 'byor ldan pas brtson par gyis: bar chad kun sel mdos skong ni: ri rab gling bzhi snod bcud kyi: bkod pa rab rdzogs dpal gtor dang : bshos bu dkar dmar rgyan ldan bsham: bla na gdugs chen nam mkha' bre: g.yas g.yon mda' 'phang pho mo'i gdong : gsal shing rgyang bu shing ris 'dzug: srog chags rnam pa du ma'i gzugs: sku glud dkor chas phyug pa sogs: yid 'phrog rgyan ldan mchod tshogs dgram:

las kyi gzhung bsrangs nga rgyal bskyed: snod bcud byin brlab mdos rten gsal: spyan drangs bzhugs gsol mchod bstod bzlas: ye shes pa rnams dbyings su bskang : 'jig rten 'byung po rdzas kyis brngan: bgegs rigs lan chags tshim par bsngo: las kyi kha sgyur gzer khas gdab: zor du 'phang ngam rang bzhin gtong : 'byung ba bzhi yi dbyings su sbyang : tshe 'gugs smon lam bkra shis sogs: rjes kyi las rim mthar dbyung ngo : des ni ye shes dgyes pa bskyed: 'jig rten lha srung 'khrugs pa zhi: dam skong rkyen zlog las kun 'grub: thun mong phrin las mchog yin no: gzhan yang rten la rab gnas kyi: 'jig rten khams su dge legs spel: tshe 'das gnas nas rim par drang : rig 'dzin gral du dbugs chen dbyung : zhi rgyas dbang drag thab khung du: las dang mthun pa'i me sbar la: lha bskyed bsreg bya'i rdzas phul bas: phrin las thams cad myur du 'grub: de sogs las kyi bye brag kun: rgyud dang man ngag bzhin bsgrub na: rang dang gzhan don phan pa che'i: dngos grub ya mtshan chen por 'gyur: sa ma ya: gnyis pa bzlas pa'i las rim la: bsnyen dang sgrub dang las la sbyar: dang po bsnyen pa'i dgongs pa ni: hūm̐: dbu rgyan kun bzang rigs lnga'i 'khor: zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi lha: cir yang 'char ba'i gtso rnams kyi: thugs kar pad zlar hūm̐ yig mthar: sngags 'phreng 'khor las bar med byung : yab yum zhal zhugs gsang bar 'khor: 'odakyis 'phags mchod 'gro sgrib sbyangs: bde gshegs zhi khro'i gsang gsum byin: bdag thim byin rlabs nus stobs 'bar: slar yang snod bcud dkyil 'khor ba'i: sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ 'bum phrag gsum gyis dngos grub thob: gnyis pa sgrub pa'i dgongs pa ni: hūm̐: dpal chen gtso dgu'i thugs ka ru: pad nyir rdo rje rtse lnga'i sbub:

sngags phreng sgrar bcas 'khod pa las: 'bar ba'i yi ge'i phreng ba byung : yab yum zhal dang zhal nas brgyud: gsang ba'i padmor bar med 'khor: bde chen gzi byin rab 'bar ba'i: 'od kyis 'khor 'das khams kun khyab: bde gshegs zhi khro mchod pas mnyes: khams gsum nyon mongs dug chen sbyangs: tshur 'dus bdag dang gnyis med thim: khrag 'thung rab 'byams byin nus rdzogs: slar 'phros tha mal snang zhen sbyangs: lha sngags chos sku'i phyag rgyar rdzogs: dpal gyi sku gsung thugs su smin: dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub par bsam: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ sarba duṣtān ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dril sgrub sngags kyi rgyal po 'di: 'bum phrag bzhi yis mchog thun 'grub: spro na bye brag bzlas pa ni: ting 'dzin gong bzhin gsal btab la: bskyed pa'i sngags rnams 'bum phrag bzlas: so so'i nus rtsal rab rdzogs byed: khyad par tshogs sgrub sogs kyi skabs: so sor bskul zhing bzlas pa bya: hūm̐: dbus nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: che mchog yon tan lha tshogs rnams: sku ni snang stong gzi byin 'bar: gsung gis grags stong sngags sgra sgrogs: thugs mchog rig stong srog ldan pa: bsnyen sgrub dzab kyis thugs dam bskul: ma grub bar tu mi btang na: ma g.yel thugs rje'i dpung bskyed la: bzlas pa'i phrin las g.yel med pas: las bzhi grub pa chen po brgyad: rig 'dzin mchog gi dngos grub rnams: da lta nyid du 'grub mdzad gsol: zhes bskul bzlas brjod ting 'dzin gsal: stong stong tshigs su mchod bstod 'bul: de ltar kha sgyur

hūm̐: shar nas sogs dang : yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams: zhes sogs rim par bsgyur ro/ mchan/ so sor bsgrub: dngos grub myur du 'grub par 'gyur: gsum pa las la sbyar ba ni: thun mong khyad par rnam pa gnyis: dang po thun mong las sbyar phyir: dgongs pa gsal zhing drag sngags bzla: hūm̐: 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis: zhal nas drag sngags 'brug ltar bsgrags: gang 'dul 'od zer mkha' khyab 'phros: nad gdon zhi zhing ye shes rgyas: rlung sems snang ba dbang du bsdus: khyad par gdug cing gtum pa yi: dgra bgegs 'byung po dregs pa'i tshogs: srung dang dgug bskrad bsad pa sogs: gzir mnan stobs 'phrog nus pa bcom: ldang med e yi dbyings su mnan: sngags kyi chu bos rgyang ring khyer: rdo rje me yis gzhob tu bsregs: stobs chen rlung gis pha mthar bskrad: ming gi lhag ma med par bsam: oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha padma kro dhī shwa rī badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la rū pa karma ram̐ ram̐ dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: brag kha dag nas chu 'bab bzhin: bar med khri phrag bzhi bzlas pas: ji ltar smros pa'i las kun 'grub: khyad par mngon spyod gzer kha'i las: phrin las sgrub pa bzhin du bya: sa ma ya: de ltar bkod pa'i bzlas pa la: sems bzung sngags kyi gsal snang bsgrub: bde chen 'khor ba'i ting 'dzin gyis: bzlas pa sngags kyi gzer gdab cing : 'phro 'du 'phro 'du chen po yis: dag pa rab 'byams gzer btab pas: tha mal sgrar snang sngags su dag: dngos grub rnam gnyis nyer rgyur smin: ngag la nus pa'i rtsal rdzogs pas: gsung gi rnal 'byor grub pa'o: sa ma ya: gsum pa rdzogs pa'i sgrub thabs ni: sngags sems sgyu lus 'od gsal dang : zung du 'jug pa'i rim lnga yis: slob dang mi slob 'od gsal 'thob: de la dang po sngags rim ni: rim pa dang po la brten nas: 'di ltar snang tsam lha yi skur:

rang shar lus dben la gnas pas: lus bsrang rlung gi dug dbyung ste: rang lus yi dam lha yi sku: snang stong chu zla lta bu yi: sku dbus rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi: dwangs shing gsal la rnyog med bsgom: de nas rlung gsal dal bar bzhag: nang du 'jug tshe am̐ gyi gdangs: sna yi sgo nas ro rkyang brgyud: dbu ma'i nang gzhug gnas pa'i tshe: āḥyi gdangs la yun bsrings bzung : ldang ba hūm̐ zhes nar gyis 'phang : de ltar yang yang goms pa las: rlung gi grangs dang kha dog dang : reg bya gsal ba'i rtags mthong zhing : sgra mtha' nā da mi shigs pa'i: gsal stong ting 'dzin skye bar 'gyur: bogs 'don steng 'og kha sbyar bskyil: gzhil te mi thub lhag med btang : de goms tsaṇḍi 'bar 'dzag bsgom: lus gnad thab mgal drug chings bya: rlung gi rkyen gyis bskul ba las: lte bar raṃ yig gnam zhal ma'i: nā da me lce phra bar 'bar: 'khor lo'i gnas nas 'khyug cing zhugs: lus kyang lcags gong mer bsregs mdog: phyi nang tsha drod 'bar bar bsam: kha sbyor rlung bzung 'bar snang brtan: de las rtsol med drod thob na: spyi bo'i haṃ yig he ru ka'i: nā da bzhos pa'i bde chen rgyun: spyi mgrin snying lter rim gyis drangs: dga' bzhi'i ye shes skyes par bsam: mi rtog ka dag ngang du bzhag: de yis drod dang bde bas thabs: byas te rlung zin rtog med ngang : tha mal ngag rlung dben pa thob: gnyis pa sems la dmigs pa ni: snying ga'i rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi dbus: dhū ti'i snying por a yig dkar: de phyir dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi: yi ge phyi nang gnyis rim dgod: dngul dkar lugs su blugs ltar bsam: snying ga'i bum can sbyor ba bcas: thog mar gsal byed so gnyis la: sems bzung snang ba'i ye shes bskyed: dbyangs yig bcu drug sems bzung bas: snang ba mched pa'i ye shes 'char: mthar ni a la sems bzung bas: nyer thob ye shes mngon gyur nas:

yid kyi rtog pas dben pa 'grub: gsum pa sgyu ma'i rim pa ni: snying nang a las 'od 'phros pas: rang lus sgrib dag ye shes sku: rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya ni: chu zla 'ja' tshon lta bur brtag: sems zin spyi bo'i 'khor lo'i dbus: a dkar las byung 'od zer gyis: rang dang snang ba thams cad kun: sgyu ma chu zla lta bu yi: dag pa rab 'byams rtse gcig bsgom: zhen pa spang zhing bogs dbyung phyir: spyi bo'i bum can sbyor ba bya: mi rtog ngang du cham mer bzhag: mi phod brdzi sogs brtul zhugs spyad: rlung sems sgyu ma lta bu yi: phyag rgya'i ye shes 'grub par 'gyur: rmi lam sgyu ma lam khyer phyir: mgrin pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su a: gsal btab bum can sbyor ba 'ching : de la rlung sems bsdus nas kyang : sems bzung rmi lam nyid du bsam: 'dzin pa'i 'dun pas mtshams sbyar la: rtog med ngang du gnyid log pa: rmi lam nam 'dod zin pa na: sgyu ma'i skur ldang dbyings su bstim: bsdu ldang sprul sgyur rtsal 'byongs nas: sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam par thar: nyin dang mtshan du brtan par 'gyur: bzhi pa 'od gsal rim pa ni: rang nyid gzhi lus lhar gsal ba'i: snying dbus dhu ti'i sbubs su āḥ dkar gsal 'od zer lnga ldan gyi: gong bu sran ma tsam du bsgom: sems gzung bum can sbyor ba 'ching : gsal snang skyes nas mi rtog bsre: rang bzhin 'od gsal ngang du bzhag: mthar ni de las 'od 'phros pas: snod bcud thams cad mer mer g.yos: smig rgyu bzhin yal a la thim: a ni skye ba med pa la: sems bzung snang ba mched dang thob: 'od gsal sems nyid a la thim: de yang mi dmigs gnyug mar bzhag: goms nas gnyid dus gong ltar bsgom: rtog med 'od gsal ngang du nyal: nyin dang mtshan dus nyams rtogs kyi: 'od gsal 'char zhing brtan pa yis: dgongs pa'i gdings chen thob par 'gyur: bogs 'byin yid dang dngos rig la:

snyoms par zhugs pa'i thabs mkhas kyi: bde rlung sems gsum thim pa las: mi rtog 'od gsal btsan thabs 'byung : lnga pa zung 'jug rim pa ni: stong par bsdu zhing snang bar ldang : ting 'dzin rtsal sbyang zhen med bskyang : rnam pa lha sku sgyu ma dang : ngo bo rtog med 'od gsal ba: bcos min ngang gis zung du 'jug: lta ba ka dag gdod ma'i babs: sgom pa snang stong gnyug mar bskyang : spyod pa tshogs drug lhug par spyad: 'bras bu dpal chen he ru ka: zung 'jug shin tu rnam dag pa'i: go 'phang mchog la dbugs 'byin 'gyur: de lta bu yi grub pa'i mtha': tshe 'dir mngon du ma gyur na: 'chi kha'i mtshams sbyor 'pho ba ni: rab kyis 'od gsal chos skur 'pho: 'bring gis sgyu ma longs skur 'pho: tha mas dmigs par bcas pa yis: sprul sku'i zhing du dbugs 'byin phyir: rang lus rtsa yi stong rar bcas: dwangs gsal rnyog pa med par bsgom: dhū ti'i tshangs bug zang thal le: mar sne lte 'og phug rdugs 'khyil: snying gar tshigs kyis bkag pa'i steng : rlung dkyil a yig gong ltar gsal: rlung sems bsdu zhing nyams skyes na: spyi bor bla ma dpal chen po: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas dmigs: gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba gdab: lus gnad bcos te thur sel drang : srog phyir 'phul dang lhan cig par: hika gis rlung sems glog 'khyug ltar: dpal chen thugs bstims gnyug mar bzhag: slar yang ka zhes rang gnas dbab: de ltar bsgom zhing thun gyi mthar: bla ma 'khor bcas rang la bstim: snying ga'i a dang dbyer med bsam: tshangs bug sna tshogs rdo rjes bkag: bum pa can gyi sbyor bas brtan: yongs su bsngo dang smon lam gdab: spyi bo za zhing skrangs pa dang : tshangs bug bye sogs rtag mthong nas: 'chi khar las sbyar tsam gyis 'grub: de yang rlung sems he ru ka'i: thugs kar bstims nas 'og min gshegs: yid la byar med 'od gsal ngang :

mkha' spyod la sogs rig 'dzin kyi: zung 'jug sku 'grub rten de las: lam gyi lhag ma bgrod de grol: gal te 'pho ba ma thebs na: srid pa bar do shar ba'i tshe: gzugs kun lha yi phyag rgyar bsre: snang stong zung 'jug dbyings su 'pho: sgra skad sngags kyi rang sgrar bsre: grags stong zung 'jug dbyings su 'pho: rtog tshogs 'od gsal chen por bsre: rig stong zung 'jug dbyings su 'pho: de yang da ltar goms pa las: bar dor dran pas sleb pa'am: rjes mthun zung 'jug go 'phang 'grub: yang na brgyud nas byang chub 'thob: de lta'i gsang mchog rgyud sde'i bcud: rmad byung lam 'di nyams len pa'i: ma 'ongs skal ldan skyes bu rnams: rim gyis 'khrid pa'i rim pa ni: mtshan nyid ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis: dad brtson brtul zhugs slob ma la: grub pa'i gnas su yo byad bsag: dbang bskur dam tshig lhag par dbog: de nas dben par bya ba btang : mi rtag nges 'byung byang sems sbyang : skyabs sems sbyang bsag nan tan bya: khyad par bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom: tshad bzung med pa'i mos gus bskyed: gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba gdab: dbang bzhi blang zhing thugs yid bsre: de nas thog mar bskyed pa'i rim: phyi ltar gsal brtan dag pa dran: yul gsum gsal ba'i ting 'dzin bsgrub: bsnyen sgrub las gsum mthar phyin bya: nang ltar lus kyi dkyil 'khor ni: rang nyid dpal chen he ru ka: phyag rgya gcig pa'i skur gsal ba'i: phyi dbyibs lus ni gzhal med khang : nang gi rtsa rlung thig le'i khams: sems dang dbyer med dkyil 'khor te: spyi gtsug bla ma rdo rje chos: gnas lngar gshin rje rta mchog dpal: yang dag che mchog kī la ya: nor bu bla med brla g.yas g.yon: dregs pa drag sngags lha tshogs gsal: thugs srog hūm̐ la sems bzung bzla: tha mal snang zhen lha skur brtag: cir snang sgyu ma lta bu'i lha: snang srid gzhir gzhengs lus dben 'grub:

de ltar sngon tu legs song nas: dngos gzhir sngags kyi rim pa sogs: ji skad bshad pa de bzhin du: nges rdzogs tshul du nyams su blang : mos pas stan gcig bsgom kyang rung : rjes ni thun mthar dge tshogs bsngo: zung 'jug 'grub pa'i smon lam gdab: thun mtshams dngos gzhi'i nyams myong bskyang : gegs sel bogs 'don thabs dang bcas: rtse gcig nyams su blangs pa las: bskyed pas sngags kyi tshogs lam bgrod: dben pa gsum gyis drod rtse dang : sgyu mas bzod chos mthar phyin nas: sku dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i: go 'phang mchog tu 'grub par 'gyur: mdor na gsang chen bla med kyi: snying po ngo mtshar rmad byung ba: ma byung 'byung bar dka' ba'i chos: bde gshegs yongs kyi bgrod gcig lam: rgyud lung man ngag thams cad kyi: 'o ma'i yang bcud zhun mar ltar: rim pa lnga dang dbang bzhi'i lam: zab cing 'dril bar bshad pa 'di: dbang rnon skal ldan rin po che'i: rigs can rnams kyi spyod yul te: bod kyi rnal 'byor thang stong par: o rgyan padma sam bha bas: gdams pa'i snying po yang dag go: sa ma ya: bzhi pa yon tan dbang bskur ni: rdo rje'i bla ma mtshan rdzogs kyis: snod ldan slob ma rjes gzung phyir: las su rung ba'i sgrub khang du: lha dang bum pa sta gon dang : slob ma lhag gnas cho gas bya: de yang khrus byas bgegs bsal bsrung : maṇḍal dang bcas gsol ba gdab: bla ma gsang sngags che ba'i mchog: khyab bdag rdo rje slob dpon gyis: khrag 'thung rol pa'i dkyil 'khor cher: bdag cag rjes su bzung mdzad gsol: yan lag brgyad kyis rgyud sbyangs par: sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga brtsam: hoḥ bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang : bde gshegs zhi khro dgongs su gsol: sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir: bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi: so sor thar dang byang chub sems: rig 'dzin sngags kyi 'dul ba spyi: khyad par rtsa ba sku gsung thugs:

yan lag dam tshig nyi shu lnga: sgrub pa lhag pa'i dam tshig rnams: tshul bzhin bzung zhing bsrung bar bgyi: gzhi lus rdo rje sems dpar bskyed: sgo gsum byin rlabs mchod par bya: lus rtsa'i dri ma sbyang ba dang : dngos grub nges par brtag pa'i phyir: rdo rje bzhad pas so shing dor: oṃ badzra ha sa haṃ: ngag dang rlung gi sgrib sbyangs shing : rmi lam gsal phyir khyor chu ni: mā ma kī yi sngags kyis sbyin: oṃ baṃ badzra mā ma kī a mṛ ta bi sho dha ya hūm̐: yid dang thig le'i sgrib sbyang zhing : rmi lam bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir: sngags mdud dmar po tshad ldan pa: rdo rje mche ba'i phyag rgyas bsang : oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐: rdo rje 'chang ba'i sngags kyis bcing : oṃ badzra bhandha baṃ: rdo rje srung bas rgyas gdab bo: oṃ badzra rakṣā haṃ: kun gzhi ye shes sgrib sbyang zhing : sngas dang stan phyir ku sha sbyin: mi g.yo mnyam pa'i sngags kyis brtan: oṃ badzra a tsa la sa ma ya st+waṃ: mi ldog phyir du chos bshad cing : rmi lam brtag par gdams nas btang : de nas dngos gzhi'i las rim ni: sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor tshul bzhin bzhengs: dbang rdzas rab gnas ldan pa dkram: bsnyen cing sgrub pas nus ldan bya: tshogs dang gtor mas mchod cing bskang : bdag nyid dam tshig gso ba'i phyir: dbang bskur blang zhing gnang ba nod: lhag par gnas pa'i slob ma rnams: sgo drung dag pa'i khrus nas dbyung : nang du zhugs la mtshams bcad cing : gdong dgab me tog phreng ba gtad: de nas gsol ba gdab pa'i phyir: maṇḍal dang bcas thal mo sbyar: khrag 'thung gtso bo khyod la 'dud: dpal chen dkyil 'khor 'jug pa dang : dbang dang byin rlabs las kyi rim: thugs rjes dgongs te stsal du gsol: zhes gsol de la slob dpon gyis: bde gshegs zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du: 'jug pa'i skal ldan shin tu dkon: dad brtson brtul zhugs spyod nus na: snying po'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya:

zhes dris de yi lan gsol ba: bdag ni dngos grub mchog la dad: rdo rje'i lam la brtson pa dang : zab mo'i brtul zhugs spyod nus phyir: nges par bka' drin bskyang bar 'tshal: zhes zhus dam tshig bdud rtsi sbyin: de ltar yin na he ru ka'i: ye shes khyod la smin par bya: dam tshig bdud rtsi 'di 'thungs la: 'da' dka'i g.yar dam tshul bzhin srungs: oṃ badzra sa ma ya u da ka ṭha: des kyang rol zhing bro bor bya: sa ma ya i daṃ na ra kan: rgyud sbyang sdom gsum khas blangs bzung : dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs dkyil 'khor du: dgug cing sgo bzhir 'jug phyag 'tshal: slar yang shar sgor 'khod pa la: rdo rje gnas gsum bzhag nas kyang : sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig sbyin: oṃḥ bde gshegs khrag 'thung rab 'byams kyi: sku yi dam tshig lus kyis srungs: nyams pa thams cad yongs spangs nas: snang stong phyag rgya 'grub par gyis: kā ya sa ma ya rakṣantu: āḥ bde gshegs khrag 'thung rab 'byams kyi: gsung gi dam tshig ngag gis srungs: nyams pa thams cad yongs spangs nas: grags stong sngags su 'grub par gyis: wā ka sa ma ya rakṣantu: hūm̐: bde gshegs khrag 'thung rab 'byams kyi: thugs kyi dam tshig yid kyis srungs: nyams pa thams cad yongs spangs nas: rig stong zung 'jug grub par gyis: tsitta sa ma ya rakṣantu: dam tshig de nyid mngon byed phyir: ye shes dbab pa'i cho ga bya: slob ma lus bsrang rlung bzung zhing : yid ni rtog med ngang du bzhag: slob dpon dpal chen he ru ka'i: thugs srog hūm̐ las ye shes kyi: 'od zer me lce lta bur byung : slob ma'i bdag rtog bag chags bsregs: rnam shes dwangs ma hūm̐ du gyur: bla ma'i zhal zhugs thugs kar zhu: rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar: he ru ka

zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ mchan/ yi skur gyur pa: sbyor mtshams nas thon gdan steng du: 'khod pa'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan: slob dpon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: thugs ka'i 'od dang bde ba'i sgras: mkha' khyab bde gshegs zhi khro'i tshogs: sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgyar sad: rgya mtshor char cher babs ltar thim: ye shes gzi byin 'bar bar bsam: dgongs pa'i gding bskyed spos rol dang : gdung ba'i glu yis thugs dam bskul: sngags mthar rig pa btags la dbab: dzñā na ā be sha ya ā be sha ya: st+wam̐ bha ya st+waṃ bha yaḥ ra ra ra ra: tsa lā ya tsa lā ya: hūm̐ a ha dzhaiṃḥ drag tu bzlas pas pheb pa na: tiṣṭha badzra sa brtan par bsgrub: 'brel ba'i lha la me tog phul: oṃ: rin chen me tog yid 'phrog rdzas: bde gshegs zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor lhar: gus pas rigs kyi lha la 'bul: thugs rjes dgongs te bzhes su gsol: badzra paṣpe pra twitstsha ho: me tog spyir bcing lhag lha bstim: hūm̐: me tog cod pan brdas mtshon te: lhag pa'i phyag rgya spyi bor bstim: byang chub bar du mi 'bral bas: dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par shog: puṣpe dzñā na siddhi hūm̐: rigs dang mthun pa'i ming yang gdags: ma rig ye shes thur mas bsal: hoḥ sngon gyi mig mkhan rgyal po yis: 'gro ba'i ling tog bsal ba ltar: de bzhin khyod gyi ma rig mig: rig pa ye shes thur mas dbye: badzra dzñā na tsakṣuḥpra be sha ya phaṭa: kye ho rdo rje'i slob ma mchog: khyed rnams las sad skal bar ldan: ye shes chen po'i spyan thob pas: dpal gyi dkyil 'khor blta bar gyis: he badzra maṇḍa la pā shya ho: zhes bskul mtshon byed rtags kyi brdas: mtshon bya don gyi dkyil 'khor bstan: phyi nang gzhan gsum dbyer med pa: mngon sum nyid du mthong bar bsam: des ni lha dang skal mnyam pas: ye shes smin pa'i snod du 'gyur: zhugs pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor cher:

dngos gzhir dbang bskur rim pa ni: maṇḍal dang bcas gsol ba gdab: byang chub rdo rje 'chang chen pos: rgyal ba rigs lngar dbugs dbyung ltar: bdag kyang yongs su smin bya'i phyir: khyab bdag chen pos bka' drin stsol: zhes zhu phan nus zab mo yi: dbang rnams rim bzhin sbyin pa la: thog mar phan pa'i dbang gi slad: dbang lha spyan drangs mchod cing gsol: slob ma rdo rje khrag 'thung bskyed: mi bskyod bdud rtsi'i chu dbang bskur: hūm̐: mi bskyod rgyal po de bzhin gshegs: bdud rtsi chu yi dbang bskur bas: rnam shes zhe sdang gnas dag nas: rdo rje'i rigs su 'grub par shog: badzra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsā mi: slob ma ratna khrag 'thung bskyed: rin 'byung dbu rgyan spyi bor bcing : hūm̐: 'dod 'byung rgyal po de bzhin gshegs: longs spyod dbu rgyan dbang bskur bas: tshor ba nga rgyal gnas dag nas: rin chen rigs su 'grub par shog: ratna mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsā mi: slob ma padma khrag 'thung bskyed: thabs kyi rdo rje lag g.yas gtad: hrīḥ dpag med rgyal po de bzhin gshegs: thabs kyi rdo rjes dbang bskur bas: 'du shes 'dod chags gnas dag nas: padma'i rigs su 'grub par shog: badzra padma a bhi ṣiñtsā mi: slob ma karma khrag 'thung bskyed: shes rab dril bu lag g.yon gtad: āḥ don grub rgyal po de bzhin gshegs: shes rab dril bus dbang bskur bas: 'du byed phrag dog gnas dag nas: las kyi rigs su 'grub par shog: badzra ghāṇḍe a bhi ṣiñtsā mi: slob ma buddha khrag 'thung bskyed: rdor dril lhan cig spyi bor 'khrol: gsang ba'i ming gis bsnyad par bya: oṃ: snang mdzad rgyal po de bzhin gshegs: rdo rje'i ming gis dbang bskur bas: gzugs snang gti mug gnas dag nas: bde gshegs rigs su 'grub par shog: buddha badzra nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsā mi: dbang gi bdud rtsi spyi bor 'khyil: bde gshegs rigs lngas dbu brgyan bsam:

dbang lha bstim zhing ye shes brtan: mchod pas mnga' dbul shis pa brjod: de ni phan dbang rnam lnga'o: de nas nus pa'i dbang bskur la: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi: rtsa ba'i dbang lngas nus byin skyed: nyan sgom 'chad phrin bdag po che: khyad par dbang lngas don gnyis spyod: nyams skong dngos grub mngon spyod tshe: 'od gsal mar mes las kun 'grub: de la dang po rtsa ba'i dbang : thog mar gtso rnams phyag rgya thogs: dbang gnas so sor bzhag cing bstim: gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs dbang thob bsam: spyi bo/ hūm̐: shin tu rnam dag ye shes sku: bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yi: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: zhi ba yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu ā: kā ya dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: lte ba/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes sku: dkyil 'khor khyab bdag dpal chen pos: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: che mchog yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ddha shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ kā ya dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: dpral ba hūm̐: mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes sku: 'jam dpal ya mānta ka yis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: gshin rje yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ a kro te ka ya mānta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: mgrin pa/ hūm̐: so sor kun rtog ye shes sku: dpal chen ha ya grī wa yis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: rta mgrin yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ padmānta kṛ ta badzra kro dha ha ya grī wa hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: snying ga hūm̐: me long lta bu'i ye shes sku: bcom ldan badzra he ru kas: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: yang dag yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya dzñā na a bhī ṣiñtsa oṃ: gsang ba/

hūm̐: bya ba nan tan ye shes sku: phrin las badzra ki la yas: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: phur pa yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: nor bu/ hūm̐: klong du gyur pa'i ye shes sku: bcom ldan bla med he ru kas: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: ma mo yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ gu hya dzñā na kro dha kro dhī ma ma yo gi nī ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: spyi gtsug hūm̐: 'da' dka' 'od gsal ye shes sku: bla ma rdo rje chos chen pos: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: rig 'dzin yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: brla g.yas/ hūm̐: dbyings su sgrol ba'i ye shes sku: dpal chen dregs pa kun 'dul gyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: dregs pa yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣtān hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: brla g.yon/ hūm̐: mtha' grol gnyug ma'i ye shes sku: dpal chen stobs ldan nag po yis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: drag sngags yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra sarba duṣtān hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: phrag pa gnyis/ hūm̐: thogs med rtsal chen ye shes sku: rdo rje mkha' lding chen po yis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: khyung chen yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra ga ru ḍa he haṃ se tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: lag tu gtad/ hūm̐: 'bar ba chen po'i ye shes sku: gnyis med ma ning nag po yis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: bka' sdod yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa gu hya hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas su:

ngo sprad bskyed rim bsgom par gdams: gsung ni sngags phreng spros la bstim: dzab dgongs gsal btab bzlas lung sbyin: sngags byang mgrin par bzhag /āḥ bde gshegs zhi khro'i lha tshogs kyi: snying po lung gi dbang bskur bas: bsnyen dang sgrub dang las sbyor gyi: bzlas pas dngos grub mchog thob shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka wā kā dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa a: sgra kun bde gshegs zhi khro yi: gsung du ngo sprad bzlas par gdams: thugs ni gnyis med ye shes dbyings: rdo rje'i rnam par spros la bstim: rdo rje snying gar bzhag /hūm̐: bde gshegs zhi khro yongs rdzogs kyi: ye shes thugs kyis dbang bskur bas: lha dang bdag nyid dbyer med pa'i: dgongs pa mi 'gyur gding thob shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka tsitta dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rtog tshogs ye shes chen po ru: ngo sprad dgongs pa bskyang bar gdams: yon tan rnam grol nus bskyed phyir: bdud rtsi'i pho brang spyi bor bzhag: dpal chen gsang gsum byin rlabs bstim: yon tan rnam grol nus pa bskyed: swā: snod ni rang byung gzhal med khang : bcud ni zhi khro yongs rdzogs lhas: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: rnam grol yon tan dbang bsgyur shog: oṃ badzra a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: gu ṇa dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa swā: dkyil 'khor 'od zhu bdud rtsir bsam: phud kyis bla ma yi dam mchod: bar pa rang gis myang zhing sbyin: bya ba mthong thos myong reg kun: yon tan rnam grol mchog la sbyar: phrin las sgrub pa'i phur bu gtad: hā: bde gshegs zhi khro yongs rdzogs kyi: 'dul thabs rnam pa thams cad pas: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: thogs med phrin las kun 'grub shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka bi shwa karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hā: byed spyod phrin las rnam pa bzhis: 'gro ba 'dul ba rjes su gdams: rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub pa'i phyir:

nyan dbang pusti rna bar bzhag: oṃ: sgra gsal thig le'i dkyil 'khor du: sngags rgyud rab 'byams dbang bskur bas: gsang ba gsang chen bla med chos: nyan cing 'dzin pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka sarba dharma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: sgom sgrub phreng ba lag tu gtad: oṃ: dran gsal thig le'i dkyil 'khor du: thugs rje gzungs kyi dbang bskur bas: bsnyen sgrub yan lag rnam pa bzhi: sgom sgrub bzlas pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka sarba bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hoḥ 'chad pa chos dung ljags la bzhag: oṃ: smra byed thig le'i dkyil 'khor du: 'chad pa lung gi dbang bskur bas: chos kyi dung ni bla med pas: 'grau 'dul mchog gi dbang thob shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka sarba bhā ṣa a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: las dbang phyag shing lag tu gtad: oṃ: skyed byed thig le'i dkyil 'khor du: rdo rje'i phyag shing dbang bskur bas: sngags kyi spyod pa'i tshul chen po'i: las rnams grub pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka sarba karma a bhi ṣiñtsa ho: slob dpon mchog tu dbugs dbyung phyir: bu rnams seng ge'i khri la bkod: rin chen gdugs 'phan rgyal mtshan 'phyar: lag tu rdo rje dril bu gtad: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sgo gsum thig le'i dkyil 'khor du: thabs shes zung 'jug dbang bskur bas: dkyil 'khor khyab bdag chen po dang : dbyer med grub pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka kā ya wā ka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐: mchod pas mnga' dbul bkra shis brjod: nyams skong dngos grub dbang bskur phyir: thog mar nyams chags zhi ba'i slad: bshags dang skong ba'i cho ga'i mthar: bdag mdun thugs nas 'od 'phros pas: 'og min zhing nas rdo rje sems: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i 'khor dang bcas: skad cig bar snang glog 'gyu ltar: mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas kyang :

nyams chags zhi ba'i dbang bskur bsam: oṃ: til gyi gang bu bzhin gang ba'i: rgyal bas bum pa bzung nas ni: 'di nyid du ni blugs mdzad pas: sdig ltung nyams chags dag par shog: yi ge brgya pa'i mthar: sarba pā paṃ kle sha ma la bi sho dha ya shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā: 'thor dang nye reg khrus byas btung : des na sdig ltung nyams chags skong : 'bras bu nad dang sdug bsngal zhi: dngos grub dbang du bya ba'i phyir: bam chen che mchog he ru ka: lus dkyil lha dang bcas pa gsal: spyi bor bzhag cing dngos grub bsdu: hūm̐: bam chen brjid pa'i pho brang du: khyab bdag khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor rdzogs: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: dngos grub mchog la dbang sgyur shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka ma hā ti ra maṇḍa la siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bam gyi lha las 'od 'phros pas: 'khor 'das nus byin bsdus shing thim: dgyes pas 'od zhu bdud rtsi dmar: kha dog lnga ldan dbyig tu 'khyil: lhar snang gsal brtan chen pos rol: 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi: dngos grub ye shes dbang gyur bsam: rjes 'brel tshogs dang dza gad sogs: sgrub pa'i rdzas rnams sbyin par bya: hoḥ rdo rje'i slob ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i tshe gsol bas tshe'i dngos grub dbang du gyur cig: thabs kyi mām̐ sa gsol bas 'khor 'das kyi nus stobs dbang du gyur cig: shes rab dza gad gsol bas bde ba chen po'i ye shes dbang du gyur cig: zhal zas kyi bye brag mang po gsol bas zhi khro phrin las kyi dngos grub thams cad dbang du gyur cig: 'dod yon gyi rnam pa thams cad longs spyod pas 'khor 'das kyi legs tshogs thams cad dbang du gyur cig: sarba karma wa shaṃ ma no ha ra siddhi siddhi hūm̐: mngon spyod drag pos byin bskyed phyir: thog mar dregs pa'i mthu dbang ni: dmar gtor gtso 'khor bris skus brgyan: sha khrag ba liṃ du mas bskor:

de nyid dregs pa'i sde dpon dang : sngags bdag bka' sdod 'khor bcas bsam: phur pa 'dril zhing lta gdeng bskyed: hūm̐: nga ni za byed chen po ste: khams gsum ma lus bsgral ba dang : gdug pa ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir: dregs pa'i tshogs rnams bsgral bar bya: e hur thum trig nan badzra kī la ya mā ra ya rbad nan: de yis dug lnga'i phung po zhig: chos kyi dbyings su bsgral ba las: slar yang bdud rtsis gsos btab pas: mthu rtsal thogs med dngos ltar bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra a mṛ ta ho: slob ma gsang bdag dregs 'dul gyi: zhabs 'og drangs shing bran du gtad: hūm̐: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu dang : sngags bdag dregs chen bco brgyad sogs: 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kun: dam ldan rdo rje'i rig pa 'dzin: he ru ka yi gdung 'tshob pa'i: bran dang khol po yang khol dang : 'bangs kyi tshul du bka' gtad na: bde gshegs khrag 'thung rab 'byams dang : rigs 'dzin brgyud par bcas pa yi: dam las ma 'da' bka' bzhin sgrubs: byin pa'i dgra bgegs sha khrag zo: bcol ba'i mngon spyod las kun mdzod: mthu dbang drag po'i stobs bskyed la: byang chub lam gyi bar chad choms: phrin las thams cad sgrub par gyis: badzra sarba duṣtān bighnān: e hur thum mā ra ya rbad: aḥyaḥmaḥduḥruḥtsaḥshaḥnaḥdza dzaḥ pā shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa: badzra sa ma ya rakṣantu: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma bsngo: oṃ badzra sarba duṣtān sarba bighnān sha trūn mā ra ya ma hā māṃ sa rakta kiṃ ni ri ti ba liṃ ta khā hi: hūm̐: dregs pa rgyud gsum 'khor dang bcas: dam las ma 'da' rjes su dgongs: rig 'dzin srung mar mnga' gsol na: dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang bstod: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srung : rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i sku dgra sgrol: mngon spyod phrin las mthar phyin pa'i: las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: ces bcol dregs tshogs slob ma la:

bdud rtsi sbyin nas dam bsre'o: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba sa ma ya a mṛ ta khā hi: las kyi dngos gzhi bsgrub pa'i phyir: drag po'i gdab phur lag tu gtad: hūm̐: drag po las kyi phur pa la: dpal chen khrag 'thung nus stobs rdzogs: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: mngon spyod las kun 'grub par shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka badzra kī la ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rū par bskyed dgug bsgral bstab bya: rab 'byams drag po'i las kun 'grub: slar yang las drug rjes gnang phyir: srung 'khor las phur thun rdzas dang : ri rab me hom 'phang zor gtad: hūm̐: slob ma dpal chen stobs ldan nag: drag po'i sngags bdag chen po la: phas rgol mi mthun kun bsrung phyir: mi phyed rdo rje'i tsakra gtad: khams gsum gdug pa bsgral ba'i phyir: phur pa bsad pa'i mtshon rnon gtad: 'gal rkyen thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir: nyungs kar la sogs thun rdzas gtad: bar chad ldang med mnan pa'i phyir: rdo rje ri rab lhun po gtad: dgra bgegs rjes med bsreg pa'i phyir: 'bar ba zhal gyi me hom gtad: 'phang bas gdug can brlag pa'i phyir: drag po zor gyi gtor ma gtad: srung bsad zlog mnan sreg pa dang : 'phang pa'i las kun mthar phyin shog: badzra rakṣa mā ra pra tyaṃ gi ra hūm̐ phaṭa: badzra st+wambha da ha bhin dha hūm̐ phaṭa: las drug mthar phyin nus thob 'gyur: mchog gi ye shes bskyed pa'i phyir: sgrub rdzas mar me spyi bor bzhag: hūm̐: bde gshegs zhi khro'i 'od gsal dbyings: ye shes mar me dgu ru shar: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: rig 'dzin rol pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka dzñā na dī pa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bhandha gcig tu zlum pa dbyings: me dgus ye shes rig pa dgu: rang shar zung 'jug brdas mtshon te: mchog gi 'od gsal mngon gyur bsam: gdung ba'i shugs bskyed smon lam gdab: tshe dang ye shes rgyas pa'i phyir:
thugs dam bskul ba

hūm̐: ye shes klong dgu sogs/ sngon 'gro bas: tshe yi 'brang rgyas spyi bor bzhag: dngos grub bhūm̐ tshe yi dngos grub sogs/ dbang dang dam rdzas sbyin: tshe bcud sba zhing rgyas gdab hūṃ/tshe bcud snying dbus sogs/ bo: de rnams kun gyi brtan byed du: slar yang rnam bum spyi bor bzhag: hūm̐: bkra shis chen po'i bum pa ni: dpal chen bzhugs pa'i pho brang ste: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: byin rlabs nus pa brtan par shog: badzra ka la sha oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī:āḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsā mi: su ra tā st+wam̐: byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis: lus gang sgrib dag dbang bskur thob: brtan cing nus pa mchog tu gyur: chu zhabs spyi bor brtan pa la: khrag 'thung rigs lngas dbu rgyan bsam: lhag gnas mchod cing shis pa gsol: de ltar phyi yi dkyil 'khor du: sgrub pa'i rdzas la brten nas kyang : bum pa'i dbang thob lus sgrib dag: bskyed bzlas phrin las sgrub la dbang : 'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'o: gsum pa zab mo'i dbang gsum ste: dang po gsang ba'i dbang bskur ni: slob mas maṇḍal gsol ba gdab: dkyil 'khor chen po'i khyab bdag kye: bum pa'i dbang bskur rtsal lags na: byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du: gsang ba'i dbang bskur bka' drin gsol: lan gsum zhu zhing mig dar 'ching : bla ma he ru ka yab yum: snyoms zhugs bde ba'i 'od dang sgras: sangs rgyas thams cad zhal du zhugs: thugs kar zhu ba'i byang chub sems: yum gyi mkha' las sbyin bar bya: ā: mu tig ltar dag byang chub sems: chags med rakta lhan cig pa: dkar dmar lhag pa'i byang chub sems: bde gshegs khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i bcud: sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig gis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: rtsa khams rlung la nus pa smin: gsang ba'i dbang mchog thob par shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka ma hā bo dhi tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa ā:

bus kyang rtog pa med sems kyis: a ho ma hā su khas myang : rtsa khams kun la thim pa yis: gsal stong bde ba skyes par bsam: nyams myong bskyang zhing mig dar 'grol: byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du: zhu bde'i rdzas la brten nas kyang : gsang ba'i dbang thob ngag sgrib dag: rlung sems sgyu ma sgom la dbang : 'bras bu longs sku thob pa'o: gnyis pa shes rab ye shes kyi: dbang bskur ched du gsol ba gdab: dga' chen ston pa mchog gcig pus: gsang ba'i dbang bskur stsal lags na: bde mchog gsang chen dkyil 'khor du: shes rab ye shes dbang bskur stsol: lan gsum gsol gdab mig dar 'ching : mtshan ldan rig ma byin brlabs sbyin: hūm̐: 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: bla med gsang ba'i yum mchog ste: bde gshegs khrag 'thung za ma tog: e yi cha byad bzang pos brgyan: lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ster mas: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: lugs 'byung lugs ldog dga' bzhi smin: shes rab ye shes dbang thob shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka ma hā mu drā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bus kyang 'du shes gsum ldan gyis: snyoms zhugs lhan skyes dga' ba bskyed: nyams myong bskyang zhing mig dar bsal: phyag rgya'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du: kha sbyor bde ba la brten nas: gsum pa'i dbang thob yid sgrib dag: 'od gsal bde ba sgom la dbang : 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'o: gsum pa don gyi dbang bskur slad: mos gus lhur bskyed gsol ba gdab: khyab bdag bde chen he ru kas: gsum pa'i dbang bskur bka' drin thob: da ni mthar thug don gyi dbang : mngon sum ye shes ngo sprod gsol: lan gsum gsol gdab lus gnad bsrang : bla mas rang byung 'ja' shel bstan: ho: thog mtha' med pa'i byang chub sems: rdo rje snying po mkha' ltar khyab: ngo bo ka dag shel lta bu: rang bzhin lhun grub 'ja' ltar snang : dbyer med zung 'jug ye shes kyis:

rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: don gyi dpal chen mngon du gyur: bzhi pa'i dbang mchog thob par shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka dzñā na dhā tu a bhi ṣiñtsa a a: dbyings rig zung 'jug gnyug ma'i gshis: bsam gyis mi khyab ngang bskyang ngo : don dam byang sems dkyil 'khor du: brda dang thabs la brten nas kyang : bzhi pa'i dbang thob shes sgrib dag: zung 'jug mthar thug sgom la dbang : 'bras bu bde chen sku 'grub shog: de ltar phan nus zab dbang gis: legs par smin la dbang gi srog: dam tshig sdom pa'i rnam bzhag bstan: bus kyang khas blang maṇḍal dang : lus dang longs spyod ltos med 'bul: dga' ston bya zhing smon lam gdab: dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i rim pa sogs: rjes kyi bya ba mthar dbyung ngo : slob dpon ma mnyes dbang ma rdzogs: dam tshig dag par ma byas pas: rig sngags bsgrub kyang log pa ste: 'bras bu med cing ngan song ltung : dbang thob dam tshig dag pa'i bu: rgyal ba rnams kyi sras su 'gyur: rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlob: yi dam mkha' 'gros dngos grub ster: chos skyong dregs pa bka' bzhin nyan: mchog thun dngos grub myur du 'grub: de phyir lam gyi rtsa ba ste: rnal 'byor rnams kyis tshul bzhin spyod: sa ma ya: lnga pa mngon spyod phrin las gzer: las drug sgo nas bsgrub pa ste: rtsa ba srung zlog bsad pa dang : mtha' sdud mnan sreg 'phang ba'o: de la thog mar las dkyil ni: las su rung ba'i sgrub khang du: dur khrod sa la stegs bu bya: ro sol byugs shing khrag gis gsher: ma traṃ khog par e gru gsum: mu khyud thod pa'i ra ba can: de phyir mtshon 'khor rtsibs brgyad dang : rdo rje'i ra ba me ris bskor: dbus rtsibs hūm̐ yig rigs gyi mdog: de steng drag po'i gtor snod du: 'bru nag dug khrag gtor zor dgu: rigs bzhi'i 'khor dang bcas pa bya: 'khor gzhan mtheb kyu khrag kong dgod:

spro na khyung dang rgyal mtshan bsgreng : steng du dar nag gur khang dbul: sha khrag rus pa rtsangs phur dang : mtshe nyungs la sogs brjid ldan par: zlog 'khor rgyas bsdus ji rigs 'dzug: srung ba'i 'khor lo'i bla re bre: mdun du drag po'i nyer spyod dang : sman gtor rakta tshogs mchod bsham: de ltar spyod pa'i las rdzogs nas: phrin las gzhung bsrang bzlas brjod kyis: bsnyen pa kha gso nus ldan bsgrub: zor dkyil lhag par gsal ba ni: hūm̐: mdun dkyil ma tram̐ gnod byed dgra bgegs gzugs: khams gsum nyon mongs dug lnga'i phung po la: mtshon cha'i char phab rten gyi khog pa zhig: dur khrod rol pa'i pho brang chen por gyur: bhūm̐ ma tram̐ ru dra maṇḍa la phaṭa: brjid ldan gtor ma khrag 'thung dpal chen dgu: rig mdangs 'khor tshogs sprul pa yang sprul bcas: khyung gi dbu brgyan ye shes me 'od 'khrugs: bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs bsam mi khyab: hūm̐ sarba he ru ka maṇḍa la hūm̐: snod kyi 'jig rten dur khrod rol pa'i zhing : bcud kyi dngos kun dpal chen khrag 'thung lha: khros 'khrugs rngams brjid 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bkod pa chen por rdzogs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: spro na spyan 'dren mchod bstod bya: de nas las drug dang po ni: 'khor lo la brten srung ba ste: bri dang bsgom dang bzlas pa ste: dang po ras sam shog bu la: tsakra rtsibs brgyad mu khyud bcas: dbus su gtso sngags ming spel mthar: ka wa tsi badzra rakṣa rakṣa bhrūm̐: gong ras drag sngags so lnga dang : rtsibs brgyad hūm̐ la dpal brgyad sngags: srung ba'i sham 'dogs dang bcas bskor: rtsibs mchan so so'i phyag mtshan dgod: de phyir gtsug tor 'khor lo'i sngags: dbyangs gsal rten snying 'dod gsol bcas: rdo ra me ri 'bar bas brgyan: sha lnga bdud rtsi dri rdzas bzhi: ga bur/ gla rtsi/ shing kun/ shu dag /nag po/

gur gum gi wang gu gul dang : bzlas pa'i nyungs kar dang bcas byugs: lhar bskyed bzlas shing brtan bzhugs gsol: sgrub pa'i dus su dal steng dgram: sgrub pa thon nas lus la 'chang : sgom pas srung ba'i dmigs pa ni: rang gi thugs srog sa bon dang : bsrung bya thams cad dbyer med pa'i: 'bar ba chen po'i 'od zer gyis: dpal chen rol pa'i thugs dam bskul: ye shes gzi byin lhag par 'phros: rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i thugs ka nas: gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba yi: ngo bo mtshon cha'i char du babs: srung ba'i gur khang khro bcu me phung phyag mtshan lnga tho phur bcas dgu'o/ mchan/ dgu la thim: mi phyed rdo rjer byin gyis brlab: lha tshogs nang du zhal gzigs nas: sngags bzlas brtan pa'i las mdzad bsam: bzlas pas srung ba'i gsang sngags ni: khro bo'i spyi sngags kyi mthar: badzra uṣṇi ṣa tsakra wa ti rakṣa rakṣa bhūm̐: stong phrag bzlas pas nus pa brtan: gnyis pa bsad pa'i bca' gzhi ni: drag po'i dkyil 'khor 'og gi char: las khung rū pa dang bcas gzhug: rdzas kyis bsad phyir thun gyi tshogs: ru sbal rnams pa'i lto bar gtams: dmigs pas bsad pa'i gzhi bzung phyir: bdag nyid dpal chen he ru ka: khros 'khrugs rngams pa'i sngags bzlas pas: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mngon spyod kyi: las la ngom thon tshul gyis bzhengs: drag po sngags kyi nus pa rnams: zor dang thun gyi rdzas la thim: bsgral ba'i zhing bcu nyams pa bdun: gsod pa'i mtshon cha chen por bsam: las sbyor drag sngags me phung mthar: bsad pa'i sngags 'di sbrel la bzla: sarba sha trūn bighān dza bhyo phaṭa hūm̐: bhandha bhandha ha na ha na mā ra ya mā ra ya ta thā ya ta thā ya bhindha bhindha hūm̐ phaṭa: brgya stong bzlas pas ngar gdags bya: de ltar sbyor ba sngon song nas: yi dam lha dang srung ma la: skong bshags bya zhing tshogs mchod 'bul: drag po'i las la thugs dam bskul:

hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings las rang shar rig pa'i rtsal: 'bar ba ye shes klong dgu'i pho brang che: shin tu mi bzad rab 'jigs dur khrod nas: khrag 'thung yongs rdzogs drag po'i las la bzhengs: sangs rgyas bstan pa rnal 'byor sgrub po la: gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs: zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul du ma 'tshal bas: mngon spyod dmod pa'i phrin las dus la bab: srung ba'i gur khang rdo rje'i thog gis shig: zlog pa'i nus pa rang gshed rang la gzir: 'gugs 'ching sdom myos phyag rgyas rten la phob: drag shul chen pos bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: gser skyems dang bcas gzu dpang gsol: brubs khung srid pa'i btson khang du: nṛ tri las skyes dgra dang bgegs: gsal gdab dgug gzhug drag du bya: slar yang che mchog stobs kyis dgug: hūm̐: che mchog yon tan lha tshogs rnams: drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: thogs med myur du rten 'dir khug: oṃ badzra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba sha trūn nri tri badzra aṃ gu sha dza: lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas rten la bstim: yang dag gzi yis mthu stobs 'phrogs: hūm̐: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams: drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par gyis: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba sha trūn bighnān a pa na ya a pa na ya hūm̐ phaṭa: smyo byed thun rdzas phyag rgyas dbab: gshin rje'i pho nyas lha dang dbye: hūm̐: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs rnams: drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: mgon skyabs 'tsho ba'i lha dang phrol: oṃ a kro te ka ya mānta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭa: pra be sha ya pra be sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa: gu gul bya 'ug dong rus dbye: slar yang dgug gzhug bcing myos bya: rta mchog rol pas gzugs la dbab:

hūm̐: padma gsung gi lha tshogs rnams: drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: bla srog rnam shes rten la phob: oṃ padmānta kṛ ta badzra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba sha trūn bighnān ā be sha ya ā be sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa: dkar nag nyungs dang phyag rgyas dbab: phur pas 'chor med byad du gzhug: hūm̐: phur pa phrin las lha tshogs rnams: drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: zung zhig rgyob cig rnam par chings: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba sha trūn bighnān shri ghrām̐ a na ya hūm̐ phaṭa: byad thag sngo dmar phyag rgyas bsdam: srid pa ma mos smyo ru gzhug: hūm̐: rbod gtong ma mo'i lha tshogs rnams: drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: rings par khug la smyo ru chug: oṃ guu hya dzñā na kro dha kro dhī ma ma yo gi nī ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba sha trūn bighnān dzwa la pa yadzwa la pa ya hūm̐ phaṭa: de nas phur bu bdug brab byug: hūm̐: khrag 'thung stobs rdzogs kī la ya: gu gul dud pas dbyings nas bzhengs: nyungs thun drag po'i las la bskul: rakta 'bar bas gzi byin bskyed: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra kī la ya su ru su ru pra su ru pra su ru ma gu ta la pra ta la rakta dzwa la hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: rdo rje thal mo'i bar du bzung : hūm̐: lag gnyis rigs lnga yab yum gyi: sbyor mtshams 'od kyis bde gshegs bskul: sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs 'dus: khams gsum dus gcig sgrol ba yi: mthu rtsal byin dbang yongs su rdzogs: oṃ badzra kī la ya kā ya wā ka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes brjod rang gi gnas gsum 'dril: bdag kyang byin rlabs nus ldan bsam: drag sngags bzla zhing tsham rngams bya: hūm̐: chos dbyings rol pa'i dur khrod nas: bka' brgyad lha tshogs dus la bab:

lcags kyus dgra bgegs snying nas drongs: rdo rje phur bus rdul du rlog: slar yang drag po'i thun rdzas dbab: hūm̐: phur bu khrag 'thung phrin las rdzogs: rakta rbod gtong ma mo'i thun: yungs kar khro rgyal stobs 'dus rdzas: mtshe mda' gdug can dregs pa'i mtshon: dug thun drag sngags gdug pa'i dbal: mtshon thun bka' sdod pho nya'i shugs: mda' rdo dpal gyi shugs 'chang bas: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: drag sngags bzla zhing thun rnams brdeg: de nas gdab ka'i las dngos ni: bdag nyid dpal chen he ru ka: phur pa sras mchog kī la ya: rū pa dgra bgegs dngos su gsal: lta ba stong nyid rdzong bzung ste: sgom pa rtse gcig 'phrang la bshar: spyod pa snying rje khros pa'i srog: tshe khrus gnas kyi dgongs par sbyar: snying gar btab pas

hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen sogs/ kha sbyor dbye: slar yang drag sngags dang bcas te: lus gnad kun tu khyab par gdab: ral gri la sogs mtshon chas gtub: hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs kyi: rno ngar ye shes ral gri yis: ma rig sgo nga'i sbubs dral nas: dgra bgegs gzugs phung rdul du rlog: sarba sha trūn bighnān tstshinda tstshinda mā' ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: mchod bstod rdo rje'i gtun du brdung : hūm̐: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs rnams: drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: gzugs phung rdul phran bzhin du rlog: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣtān hūm̐ phaṭa: ta thā ya ta thā ya hūm̐ phaṭa: drag sngags mchog chen gzer bus bstab: hūm̐: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs rnams: drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: gzugs phung rngams pa'i zhal du thob: oṃ badzra sarba duṣtān hūm̐ phaṭa: bhindha ya bhindha ya kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa: gsum pa zlog pa'i las rim la: ting 'dzin dmigs pa'i rim pa ni: slar yang rū pa'i cha shas dang : dmar gyi phud chen zor la sbrengs: hūm̐: khrag 'thung drag po'i dkyil 'khor lha: sha khrag dmar gyi mchod pa bzhes: za ba'i mche rnon dgra la gtsigs: rngams pa'i brtul zhugs bgegs la skyed: rnal 'byor bdag cag sgrub pa po'i: mi mthun 'gal rkyen bar chad kun: bhyo zlog drag po'i las la bzhengs: mngon spyod phrin las yongs rdzogs mdzod: ces bskul khrag 'thung 'khor bcas rnams: khros 'khrugs rngams pa'i gzi byin 'bar: zhal phyir gzigs nas zlog pa'i sngags: 'brug stong ldir ba ltar bsgrags pas: sku las pho nya 'bar ba'i me: g.yo byed rlung gi shugs can 'phros: byang chub sgrub la bar chad kun: rgya mtsho'i pha mthar zlog cing bskrad: ming gi lhag ma med par bsam: sdang mig gzir zhing thal mo brdab: sngags kyis zlog pa me phung sham:

badzra karma yakṣa sarba duṣtān a pa ka ra dzwā la dzwā la ram̐ ram̐ yam̐ yam̐ bhyo bhyo zlog zlog bhyo zlog cig: brgya stong bzlas shing dmigs pa gsal: bris pas zlog pa'i tsakra ni: srung ba'i 'khor lo ji bzhin la: spel tshig zlog pa'i sham bu sbyar: 'khor los sgyur ba'i sngags kyi mal: drag sngags rgyas bsdus gang rigs dang : yang zlog nying zlog sham dang bcas: sngags mgo nang du bstan pa ni: dug shog dug khrag rdzas kyis bri: rab tu gnas la gtor mar 'dzugs: 'phang pa'i dus su me la sbyang : de nas zlog pa'i las bcol ni: drag gtor ling ro cha shas la: slar yang dgra bgegs dgug bstim bsgral: sha khrag rus pa tshogs su 'bul: hūm̐: khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i pho brang che: dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal med khang : dbus kyi dkyil 'khor chen po nas: bcom ldan che mchog he ru ka: yum chen gnam zhal dbyings phyug ma: rigs bzhi khro bcu sgo skyong sogs: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams: zlog sgyur drag po'i las la bzhengs: dgra bgegs gdug pa bsgral ba yi: 'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho rol: zhe sdang rus pa'i phung po choms: gti mug sha yi ri bo bzhes: 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i brtul zhugs skyed: bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe byed cing : rnal 'byor lam gyi bar chad rkyen: gnyis snang 'khrul pa las byung ba'i: 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug zlog: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog: gdon tshogs sum brgya drug cu zlog: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog: dus min 'chi ba bco brgyad zlog: glo bur bdun brgya nyi shu zlog: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog: phyi nang drang srong dmod tshig zlog: ban bon mu stegs rig sngags zlog: sde brgyad gdug pa'i cho 'phrul zlog: sra ba sa la mnan pa zlog: gsher ba chu la gtad khram zlog: 'bar ba me la bsregs pa zlog: g.yo ba rlung 'khor bskor ba zlog:
