chag che nyam nga thams cad zlog: lo zla zhag dus keg sri zlog: mi kha gleng gzhi 'thab rtsod zlog: dngos nyams rmi lam ltas ngan zlog: pha mes dur kha bye ba zlog: lha srung bdud du babs pa zlog: dpral ba'i gshed du 'jug pa zlog: ltag pa'i bdud du 'jab pa zlog: gnam gyi 'ju thag chad pa zlog: sa yi rten phur bud pa zlog: snod kyi 'jig rten rgud pa zlog: 'byung bzhi g.yo zhing 'khrugs pa zlog: sad ser 'atsan than mu ge zlog: dus tshod dman lhag log pa zlog: bcud kyi mi dge'i rnam rtog zlog: mi phyugs nad yams god ka zlog: mtha' dmag kla klo'i rgyu 'grul zlog: bstan sel phung bshig sde 'khrugs zlog: rtsa rlung thig le'i g.yo 'khrugs zlog: gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i gnyis snang zlog: dbyings kyi rje mo g.yel ba zlog: 'jig rten mkha' 'gro 'khrugs pa zlog: las kyi mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma zlog: 'dod chags lha bu'i bdud tshogs zlog: zhe sdang 'chi bdag rngams pa zlog: gti mug nyon mongs mun pa zlog: nga rgyal phung po'i bdud sde zlog: phrag dog byad phur rbod gtong zlog: mdor na 'gal rkyen mi mthun phyaugs: zlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dgra bgegs steng du sgyur: zlog sgyur bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badzra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba duṣtān mā ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: nyungs kar brab zhing thal mo brdab: hūm̐: khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i pho brang che: dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal med khang : shar phyogs dkyil 'khor chen po nas: bcom ldan yang dag he ru ka: yum mchog kro dhī shwa ri ma: rigs bzhi'i khrag 'thung yab yum dang : ke'u seng sgo skyong dbang mo sogs: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams: zlog sgyur drag po'i las la bzhengs: sogs 'gre'o: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba duṣtān mā ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog:

hūm̐: khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i pho brang che: dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal med khang : lho phyogs dkyil 'khor chen po nas: bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: yum mchog rdo rje bi tā lī: gshed chen 'chi bdag gdong can ma: ging bdud rtsis bshan la sogs pa: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams: zlog sgyur sogs: oṃ a kro te ka ya mānta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba duṣtān mā ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i pho brang che: dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal med khang : nub phyogs dkyil 'khor chen po nas: bcom ldan padma rta mchog dpal: yum chen padma gzi ldan ma: rigs bzhi phra men zil gnon brgyad: sgo skyong khams brgya rmus long sogs: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams: zlog sgyur sogs: oṃ padmānta kṛ ta badzra kro dha ha ya grī wa hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba duṣtān mā ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i pho brang che: dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal med khang : byang phyogs dkyil 'khor chen po nas: bcom ldan badzra ku mā' ra: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma: sras mchog rigs bzhi khro rgyal bcu: sgo skyong phur bu'i srung ma sogs: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams: zlog sgyur sogs: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba duṣtān mā ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i pho brang che: dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal med khang : shar lho'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: bcom ldan bla med he ru ka: yum chen nyid zhi mu kha le: rtag rgyal rje mo sman mo dang : sgo skyong khor yug pho nya sogs: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams: zlog sgyur sogs: oṃ guu hya dzñā na kro dha kro dhī ma ma yo gi nī ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba duṣtān mā ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i pho brang che:

dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal med khang : lho nub dkyil 'khor chen po nas: bcom ldan rig 'dzin rdo rje chos: yum chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: rigs bzhi grub chen sgo skyong dang : mkha' 'gro ging gi tshogs la sogs: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams: zlog sgyur sogs: oṃ badzra ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba duṣtān mā ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i pho brang che: dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal med khang : nub byang dkyil 'khor chen po nas: bcom ldan dregs pa kun 'dul dang : yum chen srid pa spyi 'dul ma: dbang phyug che sogs sde dpon dang : gtum chen dregs byed dmag gi dpung : gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams: zlog sgyur sogs: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣtān hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba duṣtān mā ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i pho brang che: dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal med khang : byang shar dkyil 'khor chen po nas: bcom ldan dpal chen stobs ldan nag: yum chen 'byung lnga'i bdag mo dang : sngags bdag dregs pa bco brgyad sogs: gsod byed sde brgyad gdug pa'i dpung : gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams: zlog sgyur sogs: oṃ badzra sarba duṣtān hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba duṣtān mā ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i pho brang che: dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal med khang : dkyil 'khor chen po'i khor yug nas: dbang phyug mkha' 'gro ging laṅka: 'bar ma sa bdag ma sring tshogs: phyogs skyong rgyal chen brtan ma sogs: dpal gyi bka' sdod 'khor bcas rnams: zlog sgyur sogs: oṃ badzra sarba karma yaksha sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba duṣtān mā ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i pho brang che: dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal med khang : tshom bu dgu ldan dkyil 'khor che'i: gtso mchog dpal gyi mkha' dbyings su: khams gsum kun na rtsal che ba:

sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs pa'i dpal: 'dab chags rgyal po ga ru ḍa: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams: zlog sgyur sogs: oṃ badzra ga ru ḍa he haṃ se tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba duṣtān mā' ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: de ltar so sor bskul zhing zlog: slar yang dril te zlog pa ni: hūm̐: khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i pho brang che: dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal med khang : tshom bu dgu ldan dkyil 'khor nas: zhi khro rab 'byams 'bar ba'i sku: dpal chen che mchog he ru ka: yang dag khrag 'thung gshin rje gshed: rta mgrin rgyal po kī la ya: bla med rig 'dzin rdo rje chos: dregs pa kun 'dul stobs ldan nag: gtso 'khor sprul pa yang sprul bcas: las byed dpal gyi bka' sdod dang : mthu rtsal rmad byung ga ru ḍa: 'dus pa chen po'i lha tshogs rnams: zlog sgyur sogs: drag sngags mthar: sarba duṣtān ma hā shwa ri raṃ mā ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: de nas phyi ltar sgo gsum gyi: 'gal rkyen gar dgu'i phyag rgyas zlog: hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i lha: gtso 'khor sprul pa yang sprul bcas: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma bzhes: zlog sgyur drag po'i las la bzhengs: sgeg pa'i sku mchog lhun por 'gying : dpa' brtul gzi brjid nyi ltar 'bar: 'jigs rung srid zhi'i che btsan che'i: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: lus kyi nad gdon bar chad bgegs: 'jigs dang sdug bsngal thams cad kun: gnod byed dgra bgegs lus la zlog: ha har rgod pas sa gsum g.yo: brlang por gshe ba'i 'brug stong ldir: drag shul rdo rje'i sngags kyi sgra'i: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: ngag gi nad gdon bar chad bgegs: 'jigs dang sdug bsngal thams cad kun: gnod byed dgra bgegs ngag la zlog: dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje las: rngams pa'i gdangs rtsal nyi ltar shar:

zhi ba'i dbyings las ma g.yos pa'i: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: yid kyi nad gdon bar chad bgegs: 'jigs dang sdug bsngal thams cad kun: gnod byed dgra bgegs yid la zlog: drag sngags mthar: kā ya wā ka tsitta sa ma ya sarba duṣtān mā ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: nang ltar phung po rigs lngar zlog: hūm̐: gzugs kyi phung po la brten pa'i: gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i bag chags kun: snang stong dbyer med he ru ka: rdo rje rtag pa'i phyag rgyar zlog: tshor ba'i phung po la brten pa'i: gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i bag chags kun: tshor stong dbyer med he ru ka: rin chen nyi ma'i phyag rgyar zlog: 'di shes phung po la brten pa'i: gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i bag chags kun: myong stong dbyer med he ru ka: padma gar dbang phyag rgyar zlog: 'du byed phung po la brten pa'i: gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i bag chags kun: rig stong dbyer med he ru ka: rta mchog rol pa'i phyag rgyar zlog: rnam shes phung po la brten pa'i: gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i bag chags kun: rigs stong dbyer med he ru ka: rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgyar zlog: pañtsa ku la sa ma ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: gsang ba nyon mongs ye shes zlog: hūm̐: ma rig nyes pa'i rtsa ba ste: nyon mongs gti mug rnam rtog kun: chos dbyings ye shes klong du zlog: 'od gsal chen po'i phyag rgyas thob: khengs shing rngams pa'i 'dzin pa can: nyon mongs nga rgyal rnam rtog kun: mnyam nyid ye shes klong du zlog: sgyu ma lta bu'i phyag rgyas thob: yul la sred cing zhen pa yi: nyon mongs 'dod chags rnam rtog kun: sor rtog ye shes klong du zlog: bde ba chen po'i phyag rgyas thob: mi mthun 'gal ba'i rnam pa can: nyon mongs phrag dog rnam rtog kun: bya grub ye shes klong du zlog: rang grol chen po'i phyag rgyas thob: gdug cing gtum la 'bar ba yi:

nyon mongs zhe sdang rnam rtog kun: me long ye shes klong du zlog: ka dag chen po'i phyag rgyas thob: pañtsa dzñā na sa ma ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: mthar thug rtog tshogs chos skur zlog: hūm̐: 'khor 'das chos kun gdod ma nas: stong chen mkha' ltar rnam par dag: don gyi kun bzang he ru ka'i: thig le chen por dbyer med kyang : de nyid ma rig 'khrul pa las: bdag dang gzhan du rnam par brtags: nyon mongs bag chags rim gyis 'phel: 'jigs pa'i gdon dang bzhi brgya'i nad: sdang byed dgra dang gnod byed bgegs: bar chad rkyen ngan cir shar yang: 'khrul pa rmi lam lta bur snang : snang dus nyid nas ma grub pas: sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor zhig pa ltar: rang bzhin 'od gsal byang chub sems: stong pa nyid kyi ngang du bhyo: mtshan ma med pa'i dbyings su zlog: smon pa med pa'i mkha' la stims: dus gsum 'gyur ba med pa yi: phyag rgya chen por rgyas thob cig: ma hā dzñā na sa ma ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: a a aḥ zhes brjod dgongs pa dbyings su bzhag: rtog pa'i phung po brgyad khri yang : blo 'das ngang du zlog gyur na: 'gal rkyen tsam la smos ci dgos: de ltar khyad par zlog pa bzhi: dbang bzhi'i lam dang rjes 'brel ba'i: sbas don nges pa'i dgongs pa ste: gzhan du ma bstan snying la phur: sa ma ya: gzhan yang 'phyang dang gzer kha rnams: rgyas par spro na sbyar du rung : 'dir ni ches zab yang zlog dang : nying zlog man ngag rgyas bsdebs bstan: de la sngags pa nang rgyas nas: zlog pa slar log yang zlog bya: bdag gi thugs nas 'od 'phros pas: phas rgol lha srung dbang med bkug: zor chen dkyil 'khor mtha' skor du: 'dar zhing 'dud pas 'khod par bsam: dug gtor sha khrag rū pa la: byad ma dgug bstim drag tu bya: zhal du bstabs pas dbang med zos: khros 'khrugs zhe sdang ngar bskyaid bsam: sarba de ba bā la bighnān sha trūn ma hā mām̐ sa rakta kiṃ ni ri ti ba liṃ ta kha khā khā hi khā hi:

hūm̐: nyon cig phas rgol gdug can la: 'go zhing las byed lha srung tshogs: dpal chen he ru ka yi bka': rdo rje'i tha tshig snying la gzer: las ngan sdig can byad ma 'di: dang po zhe sdang pha las byung : bar du 'dod chags ma yi mngal: tha ma gti mug lte bar 'khor: dug gsum rim gyis brtas pa las: nga rgyal phrag dog rlung ltar 'tshubs: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bshig: dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang smad: nyes med sems can sdug la sbyar: khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag gi: dam las 'gal zhing bka' la brkus: byad phur rbod gtong ngan sbyor brtson: bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pas na: khyed rnams 'go zhing skyabs byed na: dpal gyi bka' chad 'bebs ta re: rdo rje khro bo gnod sbyin gyis: rke khrag gzhib cing lus srog 'phrog: de bas dam las ma 'gal bar: byad ma mkhan gyi steng du rgyugs: rang gshed rang gi steng du phob: rang sha zo la rang khrag 'thungs: 'jigs pa'i cho 'phrul ltas ngan phob: bdun brgyud rigs kyang rtsad nas chod: kha phung rjes shul med par gyis: sarba de ba pā la sa ma ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog mā ra ya rbad rbad: de nas 'jam dpal khrag 'thung tshogs: yang zlog drag po'i las la bskul: hūm̐: khrag 'thung rol pa'i pho brang che: dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal med khang : lho yi phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: 'jam dpal khrag 'thung gshin rje'i gshed: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams: bhyo zlog phrin las dus la bab: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma bzhes: lo zla zhag dus gshed kyi tshogs: grangs med nyi zer rdul ltar spros: phas rgol lha srung tshogs dang bcas: byad phur rbod gtong slar zlog pa'i: mngon spyod drag po'i brtul zhugs bskyed: rang gshed drag po rang la phob: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: lha srung bdud du babs pa dang : phyi nang 'byung ba dgra gshed kyi: byad phur rbod gtong than ltas ngan:

nad gdon chag che nyam nga dang : brgyad dang bcu drug 'jigs pa'i tshogs: 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun phyogs: sdang byed dgra yi steng du bhyo: gnod byed byad ma'i steng du zlog: rang sha zo la rang khrag 'thungs: yang zlog drag po'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ hūm̐ tri ga khrom bhyo: ma ṇi mā ra ṇi bhyo: mā ra du na bhyo: rakmo rakshan bhyo: ting ya raksha bhyo: ya ma rā dza bhyo: mā ra ya kī la ya bhyo: drag tu rbad cing bskul ba yis: gshin rje byad ma'i lha srung bcas: 'jigs pa'i ngar bskyed dmag la chas: rang gi mi mthun zlog cing bsgyur: phas rgol lhag med bcom par bsam: thal mo brdab cing dmod mo bya: gu gul bdug cing thun gtor 'phang : slar yang phyir log rtags mthong na: yang zlog dmod pa'i sbyor ba ni: dregs 'dul gsang bdag he ru ka: sprul pa'i pho nya dang bcas bskul: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'bul: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣtān hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba sha trūn bighnān mām̐ sa rakta kiṃ ni ri ti ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: hūm̐: khrag 'thung ral pa'i pho brang che: dur khrod 'jigs pa'i gzhal med khang : nub byang mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor nas: gsang bdag dregs pa kun 'dul che: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma rol: nying zlog phrin las dus la bab: thugs las sprul pa'i pho nya ni: srid gsum g.yo zhing 'khrugs byed pa: sngags rgod lokt+ri pā la che: 'bum phrag dmod pa'i drang srong tshogs: dregs pa'i sde dpon dpung dang bcas: glog ltar 'khyugs shing thogs ltar phob: gdug can zhing bcu tshang ba yi: byad ma brlang por spyod pa yis: slar yang zlog pa'i las sbyor gyis: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: lus kyi na tsha byung ba rnams: byad ma mkhan gyi steng du bhyo: sems kyi rnam g.yeng sdug bsngal kun: byad ma mkhan gyi steng du zlog: 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug kun:

byad ma mkhan gyi steng du bhyo: sde brgyad gdug pa'i cho 'phrul dpung : byad ma mkhan gyi steng du zlog: lha srung bdud du babs pa rnams: byad ma mkhan gyi steng du bhyo: chag che nyam nga than ltas ngan: byad ma mkhan gyi steng du zlog: mo pra rmi lam dngos nyams 'tshubs: byad ma mkhan gyi steng du bhyo: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad kun: byad ma mkhan gyi steng du zlog: ban bon sngags pa'i mthu gtad kun: byad ma mkhan gyi steng du bhyo: hom dang sdeb gshor spar bu bskor: byad ma mkhan gyi steng du zlog: snod bcud rgud cing 'khrugs pa'i tshogs: byad ma mkhan gyi steng du bhyo: mdor na 'gal rkyen mi mthun kun: byad ma mkhan gyi steng du zlog: dgra bgegs byad ma 'khor bcas rnams: bhyo zlog dmod pa'i gad mos thob: rdo rje lhun po'i phyag rgyas non: rigs sngags rgya mtsho'i rba la g.yengs: drag shul stobs rdzogs me yi sregs: mi bzad drag sngags rlung gis gtor: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byad ma rnams: gtor ma 'di dang mnyam du bzhes: drag shul phrin las yongs rdzogs mdzod: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣtān hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ lokt+ri pā la nan: sā ga pa sha nan: nā ga du du nan: ma maṃ ma maṃ: tsir tsar tsir tsar: baṃ ru lu baṃ ru lu: rbad kra ko sha ya rbad kra ko sha ya: ho ra ho ra nan: tsi du sod: tsi du sod: shig lhur gtubs: ha la pa ti nan: 'khor ba thul: gnod byed 'byung po kā wā tsi brlag brlag: sarba duṣtān sa ma ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: dmod mo 'ur zhing thal mo brdab: 'byung bzhi'i thun zor gnod phyogs 'phang : byad ma ji ltar stobs chen yang : skad cig nyid la brlag par 'gyur: mthar thug yang zlog nying zlog bcas: ma byung 'byung dka'i rig sngags che: zab cing 'dril bar bstan pa'o: sa ma ya: de ltar yang zlog nying zlog ni: las kyi yan lag gtso bo ste: gzhan yang badzra he ru kas:

gza' klu sa bdag cho 'phrul zlog: rta mchog rol pas rgyal bsen zlog: phur pas bar chad thams cad zlog: ma mos nad rims dal yams zlog: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gros bsun ma zlog: drag sngags mthu gtad mnan pa zlog: rdo rje khyung gis ltas ngan zlog: bka' sdod pho nyas rkyen zlog pa'i: las kyi mde kha ci rigs sbyar: rno la ngar gyis btags bzhin 'gyur: sa ma ya: de ltar las kyi rtsa ba gsum: zab cing 'dril bar rab bstan nas: yan lag las kyi rjes bsdu ba: srung ba'i mtha' sdud mnan pa'i gzer: dgra bgegs rū pa tshul bzhin bris: thun rdzas dang bcas thod ngan gzhug: phung res dril zhing rtsang phur gzer: hom du gzhug cing dgug bstim bsgral: lha rten drag po gnas pa'am: gnam sa gru gsum lam rgya gram: mtsho gnyan la sogs 'jigs pa'i sar: brub khung nang gzhug dgug gzhug bcing : gshin rje chu srin gre bar gtad: nam yang 'chor ba med par bsam: me chu sa yis rgyas gdab cing : las 'jug rdo rje'i bro yis bsdu: des ni srung ba'i las mthar phyin: bar du gcod pa'i skabs bral 'gyur: sa ma ya: bsang ba'i las kyi mtha' bsdu ba: hom la brten nas sreg pa'i gzer: drag po'i sa la stegs bu bya: mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i thab khung du: gdug pa'i shing brtsigs me sbar la: las rim rgyas par bya ba'am: glo bur sreg pa'i las sgrub na: 'bar ba'i dbus su skad cig gis: dpal chen lha tshogs gsal bar bskyed: ye shes spyan drangs bzhugs su gsol: phyag 'tshal byon skyems 'bul ba dang : mchod cing bstod pa ci rigs mthar: tsha ba'i mar khu yam shing 'bul: rū pa dgra bgegs gsal zhing dgug: gdab ka'i rim pa gang 'os dang : sngar bsgral ling ro rū pa sogs: dum bur gtubs shing drag rdzas bsres: drag sngags me phung 'bar ba'i sham: sarba sha trūn bighnān ma hā mām̐ sa rakta kiṃ ni ri ti kha kha khā hi khā hi: da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa ram̐ dzwa la mā ra ya phaṭa:

brgyad tshan re re'i tha ma ru: spel tshig dmod mo dang bcas pa: drug cu rtsa bzhi rdzogs par bsreg: mthar ni gshegs skyems mchod bstod bya: 'dod don gsol zhing nongs pa bshags: ye shes gshegs shing dam tshig pa: 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i me lce yis: dgra bgegs lhag med bsregs par bsam: me zor brgyad sogs gang 'thad bya: de nas dug khrag chu yis gzhil: thal ba lha rten drag po'i 'og: gtad pas bsad las mthar phyin 'gyur: sa ma ya: zlog pa'i mtha' sdud 'phang ba la: brten pa zor gyi gzer kha ni: phyir zlog rtags mtshan thon pa na: drags sngags mthar: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho: zor chen rdzas kyi ye shes pa: bdag nyid dpal gyi thugs kar thim: khams gsum che btsan 'gran med pa'i: byin rlabs gzi brjid 'bar bar bsam: sgo dbye phye ba'i rgya dang bcas: hūm̐: byams pa tshad med lcags kyu mas: zor chen dkyil 'khor shar sgo phyes: khrag 'thung lha tshogs gzi byin skyed: shar phyogs dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: dzaḥbadzra pra we sha ya phaṭa: hūm̐: snying rje tshad med zhags pa mas: zor chen dkyil 'khor lho sgo phyes: khrag 'thung lha tshogs gzi byin skyed: lho phyogs dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: hūm̐ badzra pra we sha ya phaṭa: hūm̐: dga' ba tshad med lcags sgrog mas: zor chen dkyil 'khor nub sgo phyes: khrag 'thung lha tshogs gzi byin skyed: nub phyogs dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: bam̐ badzra pra we sha ya phaṭa: hūm̐: btang snyoms tshad med dril bu mas: zor chen dkyil 'khor byang sgo phyes: khrag 'thung lha tshogs gzi byin skyed: byang phyogs dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: hoḥbadzra pra we sha ya phaṭa: thugs dam bskul zhing chad tho bsgrag: drag sngags bzla zhing zor rdzas bcas: gom pa bdun cu'i bar du dpag: zor lam bstan cing 'phang sar khyer: gser skyems btang zhing 'phrang bsal nas: dmigs rten 'bem du bcas pa la: dgra bgegs dgug bstim dngos su gsal:

de la zor rnam rim par 'phang : hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen he ru ka: 'khor 'das kun gyi mthu stobs rdzogs: sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje'i ngang : sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par sbyor: drag shul gar gyis sa gsum g.yo: 'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bsgyel: snying rje khros pas dgra bgegs gsod: sprul pa'i pho nya ser ltar 'dril: zor rdzas mtshon cha'i char chen 'bebs: sdang dgra gnod bgegs thal bar rlog: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs kyi: stobs chen 'dus pa rdo yi zor: dgra bgegs klad pa'i dkyil du yā: gzugs phung thal ba'i rdul du rlog: padma gsung gi lha tshogs kyi: drag sngags 'dus pa mtshe yi zor: dgra bgegs rna ba'i dkyil du yā: thos pa'i sgo la phyag rgyas thob: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs kyi: nus rtsal 'dus pa dug gi zor: dgra bgegs snying gi dkyil du yā: rtog ngan 'od gsal thig ler stims: che mchog yon tan lha tshogs kyi: gzi byin 'bar ba gtor ma'i zor: dgra bgegs lte ba'i dkyil du yā: mthu stobs nus pa thal bar rlog: phur pa phrin las lha tshogs kyi: thal 'byin 'bigs pa phur bu'i zor: dgra bgegs gsang ba'i dkyil du yā: bdun brgyud rigs kyang rtsad nas chod: ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs kyi: dal yams 'dus pa khrag gi zor: dgra bgegs yul gyi steng du yā: nad rims gdug pa'i char chen phob: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kyi: nus stobs ri rab kong gi zor: dgra bgegs rten gyi mkhar la yā: thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du shig: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs kyi: gnod gdug chen po mda' yi zor: dgra bgegs mig dang lce la yā: lta dang smra ba'i rgyun lam chod: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs kyi: shugs sgrol chen po mtshon cha'i zor: dgra bgegs lnga phung kun la yā: dum bur gtubs shing phye mar thongs: drag po zor gyi rdo rje'i thog: dgra bgegs gnod byed steng du phob:

kha phung thongs la rjes med shig: dgra dpung bdun brgyud rtsad nas chad: bgegs dpung thal ba'i rdul du rlog: mngon spyod phrin las mthar phyin mdzod: drag sngags bzla zhing dgra phyogs 'phang : rngams pa'i stobs dang phyag rgya sgyur: dpal gyi zor chen dam tshig pa: rang thim gzi byin nus stobs 'bar: slar yang khro bo'i dmag tshogs dang : zor rdzas mtshon gyi rno ngar bcas: dgra bo'i steng du glog ltar 'khyug: rjes shul lhag med bcom par bsam: hūm̐ hūm̐: zhi ba chen po'i dbyings las ma g.yos kyang : bdud 'dul ye shes khrag 'thung rol ba'i lha: zung 'jug klong dgu'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams dang : dpal gyi bka' sdod mthu rtsal ga ru ḍa: gtso 'khor sprul pa bran dang pho nya'i tshogs: de ring drag po zor gyi las la bzhengs: mi bzad 'bar ba chen po'i gzi byin skyed: zor rdzas nad mtshon dug gi char chen pos: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi: byang chub sgrub la bar du gcod pa yi: nad gdon 'gal rkyen chag che nyam nga kun: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshigs pa'i spyi dgra dang : rnal 'byor thad du langs pa'i sgos kyi dgra: gnas skabs mthar thug gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bgegs: bdud bzhi'i dmag tshogs phyi nang nyer 'tshe'i rkyen: bdud bzhi'i dpung dang bcas pa'i steng du zlog: sdang byed dgra bo byad ma rtsad nas chod: gnod byed bgegs dpung thal ba'i rdul du rlog: mi ldog ye shes phyag rgya'i gzer chen thob: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las yongs rdzogs mdzod: drag sngags 'ur zhing sgyogs su 'phang : drag po'i sgra yi tsham rngams dang : thal mo brdab cing stangs stabs sgyur: dgra bgegs rdul du brlag par bsam: dgongs pa'i gding bskyed lta stangs gzir: phyi lam gcod cing brtan ma bskyang : sgo drung dam sri rjes 'brangs mnan: nang du tshe 'gugs dngos grub gsol: gtang rag la sogs las kyi rim:

phrin las bzhin du mthar dbyung ngo: sa ma ya: dhī/: rgya gar skad du: he ru ka sarba ta thā ga ta saṃ gra ha tant+ra pra garbha: bod skad du: khrag 'thung bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi yang snying : dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: chos kun gdod nas dag pa'i mkha': klong dgu'i dbyings kyi pho brang cher: kun bzang che mchog he ru kas: nyid las mi gzhan 'khor rnams la: rdo rje'i sngags rgyud rtag tu gsungs: de tshe gnam zhal tsaṇḍa līs: dgyes pa bskyed nas slar yang zhus: e ma khyab bdag dpal chen po: rgyud don snying po ji ltar lags: de skad gsol ba'i don dgongs nas: chos nyid rang sgras bka' stsal pa: ngo bos dag pa gzhi yi rgyud: glo bur dag byed lam gyi rgyud: dag pa mthar phyin 'bras bu'i rgyud: gsum gyis rgyud don thams cad bsdus: de las rtogs shing goms pa'i lam: phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i: dkyil 'khor chen po rnam pa bzhir: phan pa'i dbang dang nus pa'i dbang : zab mo'i dbang bzhi rim par blang : spyi dang khyad par lhag pa yi: dam tshig dag pas gzhi bzung ste: 'khor 'das chos kun bden pa gnyis: dbyer med chen por gtan la dbab: snang dang zhen pa sbyang ba'i phyir: rim gnyis ting 'dzin rtse gcig bsgom: nyams dang drod dang rtags rnams ni: spyod pa gsum gyis brtan par bya: bsnyen sgrub yan lag rnam pa bzhis: thun mong mchog gi dngos grub len: dam tshig las chos phyag rgya ches: 'da' dka'i thugs dam brtan cing bskul: glu gar phyi nang gsang rmad byung : bstod pa'i mchod pas dgyes pa bskyed: bkod dang spro bsdu mkha' mnyam pa'i: bsnyen sgrub las kyi bzlas par brtson: grub pa zhi rgyas dbang drag dang : mchog gi phrin las don la sbyar: de ltar shes pa'i rnal 'byor pa: he ru ka yi gdung 'dzin to: brjod 'brel dgos pa phun tshogs pa'i: rgyud kyi snying po 'di kho na: rang shar rol pa'i 'khor gyis zungs:

ma 'ongs don du snang bar gyis: zhes gsungs thig le chen por 'khyil: dpal khrag 'thung bde gshegs 'dus pa'i yang snying gi rgyud rdzogs so: sa ma ya: de nas gsang chen bshad bya ba: rig 'dzin badzra pra dharmas: rgyud don nyams su len pa'i lung : dgyes pa chen pos 'di skad gsungs: e ma 'dus pa'i 'khor rnams nyon: ma 'ongs phyi ma phyi ma'i dus: smin cing dag pa'i rnal 'byor pas: dpal mchog bde chen rdo rje'i tshig: rgyud gsum yan lag dang bcas pa: rnal 'byor lnga yis bsgrub par bya: bsgrub bya'i lha ni sems yin te: sems nyid don gyi lha skur bzhugs: de nyid lam du bslang ba'i phyir: rtags kyi phyag rgya gsal gdab cing : ting 'dzin rtse gcig gzer chen gdab: nga rgyal brtan cing dag pa dran: sku yi rdo rje'i dngos grub 'gyur: sgrub pa'i gzhung bsrang bkod dang phyogs: spro bsdus las sbyar cir snang kun: lha dang sngags kyi rgyas btab pas: gsung gi rdo rje'i dngos grub 'gyur: rdo rje'i rlung bzlas sems la dmigs: sgyu mar blta zhing 'od gsal bsdu: zung 'jug chen po'i rtsal sbyangs pas: thugs kyi rdo rje'i dngos grub 'gyur: dad dang brtson 'grus brtul zhugs can: phan nus zab mo'i dbang gi chus: sbyangs shing smin pa'i thabs chen pos: yon tan rdo rje'i dngos grub 'gyur: zhi rgyas dbang gi sbyor ba dang : khyad par gdug cing gtum pa'i yul: las drug sgo nas tshar bcad pas: phrin las rdo rje'i dngos grub 'gyur: de yis thun mong las kun 'grub: mchog tu rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhis: slob pa'i zung 'jug mthar phyin nas: mi 'gyur rtag pa'i dngos grub 'gyur: de phyir phyi rabs skal ldan rnams: 'di nyid kho nar sgrub par gyis: zhes gsungs rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i 'khor: shin tu dgyes pas yi rang ngo : sa ma ya: de ltar zab rgyas rgyud kun dang : khyad par snying po'i rgyud lung 'di:

dpal chen dgyes pas byin brlabs shing : kun 'dus rig 'dzin padma las: bod kyi rnal 'byor bdag gis thob: dpe rgyud rgyas par bris pa'i gzhung : gzhan du spel bar blos ma thongs: sgrub ste snying po'i bstan pa'i btsas: lha rtse'i brag la gter du gtams: snyan brgyud snying po'i man ngag 'di: nga sprul sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i don: klong gsal dbyings kyi sgrom bur sbas: ye shes rig pa'i brdas mtshon te: dgongs pas byin brlab gter du brdol: rtsol ba med par gtan phab nas: rang gzhan don gnyis spyod par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: slar yang yid ches spro ba'i phyir: nges shes skyed pa'i lung byang ni: dus gsum mkhyen pa padma yis: rdo rje'i gsung las 'di skad du: zhi ba thugs rje chen po dang : drag po khro rgyal rta mgrin gnyis: dbyer med gcig tu sprul pa las: sku yi cha lugs zhi ma khro: mdog smug dri zhim sme bas brgyan: rang rgyud dal zhing rig rtsal che: ma nges spyod pa sna tshogs skyong : nang rtags ya mtshan ston pa 'byung : zhes dang de bzhin gzhan las kyang : 'ol ba zhes bya'i shar mdun du: brtson 'grus zhes bya'i skyes bu 'byung : de ni nga yi thugs sprul yin: zhes dang padma'i sprul pa ni: thang stong pa zhes bya ba 'byung : de dus bod khams cung zad bde: phan bde'i snang ba thengs gcig 'byung : zhes dang nga sprul thang stong pas: chu bo che la lcags zam 'dzugs: mtha' dbus sa gnad me btsa' gso: rgyal khams dge ba'i las la bkod: kla klo'i mun gling dkar por bsgyur: 'brel tshad don ldan e ma ho: zhes sogs rgya cher yang yang gsungs: ji skad lung gis bstan pa ltar: me nyag rig 'dzin ldang gi bu: bod kyi rnal 'byor brtson 'grus bdag: 'ol ba lha rtse'i shar gyi char: skyes tsam nyid nas dge mtshan dang : ngo mtshar cho 'phrul du ma byung : dran pas zin nas chos snang skyes:

paṇa grub bla ma lnga brgya bsten: thos bsam sgro 'dogs yin lugs bcad: rtse gcig bsgoms pas drod rtags dbyung : rgya gar rgya nag bal po mon: bod khams kun du brtul zhugs sbyang : nad mug mtshon 'khrugs bcad cing bsdums: snod bcud rgud pa thams cad gsos: mtha' dbus dge bcu'i khrims la sbyar: sa gnad me btsa' mang du gsos: hor dmag zlog cing kla klo btul: chu bo che la lcags zam btsugs: byang chub rgyun lam bde bar bsgrubs: khyad par rnga yab gling du phyin: zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang du: padma he ru ka dpal mjal: sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad kyi: dbang dang gdams ngag rgya cher stsal: khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i lha tshogs mthong : byin gyis brlabs shing sngags rgyud gtad: ye shes mkha' 'gros dngos dbang stsal: nang gi sa lam skad cig bgrod: ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' las: 'bras bu rdzogs pa chen po thob: seng ldeng 'khrigs pa'i nags khrod du: dzñā na ḍā ki ni guptas: thabs grol lam mchog stsal ba las: sgom pa'i nyams myong bogs chen thon: ras sme shwa ra'i dur khrod cher: dbyings yum rdo rje phag mo yis: brtul zhugs spyod pa'i snyan brgyud gdams: bod yul gtsang gi g.yas ru'i mthil: 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po yis: rnam thar sgo gsum ngo sprad pas: dbu ma'i lta ba mngon du gyur: lta sgom spyod 'bras bogs 'don dang : bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi ldan pa'i: gzhung dang man ngag lag len don: skal ldan rnams la ci rigs bstan: 'on kyang snod mchog nyung ba'i phyir: 'ga' zhig rdo rje'i brag la sbas: la la snyan brgyud bka' rgyas btab: snying po las kyang snying po'i bcud: klong lnga dbyings kyi sgrom bu ru: rig pa'i ye shes gzungs su gdams: chos bdag mkha' 'gro gnyer du bskos: ma 'ongs nga sprul skyes bu la: dgongs pa'i klong nas rang shar ba'i: rten 'brel brda thabs du ma dang :

byin rlabs 'pho bas dbugs dbyung 'gyur: sa ma ya: 'o ma'i nang nas mar dang ni: mar gyi snying po zhun byas ltar: lta sgom spyod 'bras bogs 'don dang : sgrub pa'i gzhung dang yan lag bcas: rnal 'byor bdag gi snying thig 'di: bod kyi rig 'dzin sngags pa gzhan: su la'ang 'pho ba'i skabs med pas: rin chen lta bu'i gang zag ni: gcig car rigs can brtul zhugs mtho: sus kyang mi dpog rang zung thub: bdag dang gnyis min rnal 'byor pa: mtshan nyid lnga dang ldan pa zhig: 'di nas bdun brgya'i lo khongs su: mdo khams bar nas 'brug gi lo: gnyos kyi rig 'dzin sga yi bu: lcags khams dpa' bo mtshan rtags can: padma rgyal pos byin brlabs pas: bka' babs bdun ldan mdo sngags gling : bi ma mi tras byin brlabs pas: 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje ste: 'jam dpal sprul pa'i mnga' bdag gis: byin brlabs chos kyi bshes gnyen zhes: sgyu ma lta bu'i skyes bu 'byung : de la gnas gsum mkha' 'gro dang : dpa' bo bdag gis byin brlabs pas: gdams pa'i snying po klong brdol tshe: the tshom ma byed gtan la phob: ring du gsang zhing bka' rgyas thob: nam zhig rten 'brel dus bab na: bi ma bai ro dzñā na dang : mnga' bdag yab sras mtsho rgyal lcam: gnubs chen nam snying sangs rgyas dang : mchog dbyangs bdud 'joms dpal seng sogs: 'dus pa mchog gis byin brlabs pa: de dag rnams kyis gsol btab na: gdams pa lhag ma med par byin: cung zad don du 'gyur ba dang : khyad par las can gcig srid pas: de yi gzhan phan btsas su byed: 'on kyang dus de shin tu snyigs: lugs gnyis bya ba ches cher 'chol: khyad par sgrub pa'i man ngag 'chal: mkhas pa sgra tshad rtog ges g.yeng : sgrub pas bsnyen sgrub gzhung mi bsrang : grub thob rdzun gyi 'khor lo bskor: rtogs ldan 'dod pa'i rgya mtshor byings: bya btang gting nas mdud pa dam: mdor na rdo rje'i gsang ba che'i:

rang tshugs thub pa nyin skar tsam: blo mang col chung mdo don shor: de dang de 'dras sny-ing po'i bstan: ri mo'i mar me bzhin du byed: mtha' dbus phyi nang 'khrug rtsod langs: snod bcud sngar med 'gyur ldog mang : mi phyugs glo bur nad kyis khyer: 'gal rkyen drwa ba bzhin du 'dzings: de lta bu yi dus kyi tshe: skal ldan 'ga' zhig byung srid na: kha khyer tshig phyir ma yengs par: 'dir zhugs 'di ltos 'di don sgom: tshe gcig dngos grub nges par 'thob: mar me 'chi kha bsabs pa ltar: snyigs dus gdung ba'i gsos gyur te: rang gzhan don gnyis phun sum tshogs: nges don bstan dang 'gro la phan: de phyir snying las gces par zungs: rtsa gsum srung ma'i bden stobs dang : rnal 'byor bdag gi smon lam mthus: sgrub brgyud bstan dang de 'dzin la: phan pa rgya cher 'byung bar shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu hya: brda thim: sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi lam srol tshig nyung yang don gyi snying po rang rkang tshugs pa 'di nyid rje grub thob chen po'i gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs yang nas yang du thob pa la brten nas/ padma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa 'jam dpal chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis gtan la phab ste/ rig 'dzin grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba o rgyan 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling par phul ba ste 'di'i brgyud pa'i nges pa'ang*/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ /longs sku che mchog he ru ka /ston pa rdo rje sems dpa'/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo/ /grub pa'i rig 'dzin rnam brgyad/ kun 'dus padma sam bha ba/ rje grub thob chen po thang stong rgyal po zhes drang bar bya'o// // PAGE PAGE 43 FILENAME P-25.doc
